 Notre Maison
 Fondée à Rome en 1884 par Sotirio Bulgari, talentueux orfèvre grec, la Maison Bvlgari devient rapidement un emblème de l’excellence italienne à travers de magnifiques créations joaillières nées d’un savoir-faire et d'un artisanat incomparables. L’esprit entrepreneurial de la famille Bulgari a permis de transformer l’entreprise en une Maison de renommée mondiale. Bvlgari compte aujourd’hui cinq secteurs d’activité : joaillerie, horlogerie, parfums, accessoires, et hôtels. Basées en Suisse, nos divisions Horlogerie et Parfums offrent un environnement authentique et passionnant avec des belles opportunités de carrières.
 Notre opportunité
Au sein de notre équipe Continuous Improvement & Transformation basée à Neuchâtel, nous recherchons un :
 Continuous Improvement & Transformation Project Manager
 Rattaché au Continuous Improvement & Transformation Senior Manager, votre mission consiste à mener des projets stratégiques afin d'optimiser les processus internes de l'entreprise, favoriser la collaboration transversale, introduire des solutions digitales et/ou système, tout en participant activement à la gestion du changement.
Vous rejoignez une équipe reconnue pour sa capacité à fédérer les métiers autour de projets de transformation à fort impact, en transformant les besoins des équipes en solutions concrètes, pragmatiques et innovantes.
Au sein de ce département, nous sommes convaincus que la performance naît de la collaboration entre les métiers, soutenue par les technologies les plus adaptées. Notre ambition est de mettre les opportunités technologiques au service des équipes afin de simplifier les processus, renforcer la collaboration et créer durablement de la valeur.
Dans cette dynamique, nous renforçons aujourd'hui notre collaboration avec la division Parfums afin d'y développer des projets transversaux visant à optimiser les processus, renforcer les synergies entre les équipes et accélérer la transformation digitale.
En interaction directe avec les métiers, vous analysez les besoins, animez des ateliers, challengez les pratiques existantes et accompagnez les équipes dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de nouvelles façons de travailler.
Véritable facilitateur, vous apporterez une vision business 360° afin d'identifier les optimisations et les technologies les plus pertinentes pour répondre aux enjeux des métiers.
Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international et collaborerez avec de nombreux départements ainsi qu'avec les équipes Data, BI & AI de la Maison BVLGARI et du Groupe LVMH.
Grâce à la diversité des projets et des métiers avec lesquels vous collaborerez, vous développerez une vision transverse unique de l'organisation et contribuerez directement aux grandes transformations de notre Maison.
Votre Parcours
Fort de plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion de projets transversaux, vous avez piloté des initiatives visant à optimiser ou transformer des processus, implémenter des systèmes et accompagner des projets de transformation business et digitale. Curieux et orienté solutions, vous appréciez évoluer dans des environnements complexes où la collaboration entre les métiers est un facteur clé de réussite.
Vous maîtrisez les méthodes et outils de l'amélioration continue ainsi que les fondamentaux du Lean Manufacturing. Vous manifestez également un fort intérêt pour les sujets liés à la transformation digitale, à la data et à l'intelligence artificielle, et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches pour répondre aux enjeux des métiers.
Vous avez une appétence pour la data et maîtrisez l'exploitation de données via des requêtes SQL et/ou la création d'outils de reporting (Power BI ou équivalent). Vous faites le lien entre les équipes Business (expertise métier) et les équipes techniques (développeurs internes, équipes Data & AI de la Maison Bulgari ou du Groupe LVMH, etc.) afin de transformer les besoins opérationnels en solutions concrètes. Une expérience en tant que Product Owner (méthodologie Agile / SCRUM) ou Business Process Owner sur des projets impliquant le développement d'applications web, de solutions AI ou de systèmes tels que SAP constitue un atout significatif.
Acteur du changement, vous savez fédérer des équipes aux expertises variées et créer une dynamique collaborative autour de projets transversaux. Pragmatique, analytique et doté d'une vision d'ensemble, vous êtes capable de prendre du recul afin d'identifier les leviers de transformation les plus pertinents et d'accompagner leur mise en œuvre.
Vous êtes disposé à vous déplacer sur nos différents sites en Suisse. Parlant français et anglais, vous évoluez naturellement dans un environnement international ; la maîtrise de l'italien constitue un atout.
Nos Avantages
 - Un processus d’intégration pensé pour vous accueillir dès le premier jour, avec des rencontres avec les équipes et du temps dédié à l’échange et à la compréhension de l’environnement
 - Une ambiance bienveillante, dynamique et collaborative, où chacun peut s’exprimer librement
 - Des espaces de pause accueillants : cafés et boissons chaudes offerts, cafétérias conviviales, terrasses pour se retrouver au soleil
 - L’opportunité de rejoindre nos B-Clubs (yoga, course à pied, golf, musique etc.) et de partager des moments conviviaux avec des collègues
 - Une atmosphère multiculturelle et internationale, idéale pour élargir ses horizons
 - Une LPP avantageuse et des participations à l’assurance maladie et aux frais de repas
 - Un environnement flexible avec possibilité de télétravail (à confirmer selon éligibilité), assorti d’un kit informatique complet
 - Un parking gratuit pour voitures et vélos, ainsi que des bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques, alliant praticité et engagement en faveur d’une mobilité responsable
 - Un service de navette gratuite reliant la gare et le siège de Neuchâtel
 - Une large gamme de formations techniques, interpersonnelles et managériales
 Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et à tous, dans le respect de l’égalité des chances et de la diversité.

 About Us 
 Canadian Manufacturers & Exporters (CME) is a national community of manufacturers helping businesses grow, compete, and succeed. Through hands-on programs and services, and by shaping government policy, CME helps manufacturers improve productivity, reduce costs, and navigate the challenges they cannot solve alone.
 About the Role 
 The Lean Facilitator will provide training and support primarily to CME external members. CME Lean facilitators work closely with manufacturers, supporting them in their Operational Excellence journey. The role delivers training, assessments, and coaches the organization on its operational excellence journey. This contract role will support the development and pilot of new programs related to technology adoption, sustainable supply chain, reliability, and AI adoption.
 This is a two-year contract role with an opportunity for extension. 
 Location : Alberta (remote).
 Duties and Responsibilities :
 Training Facilitation 
 •Design, develop, and deliver a comprehensive suite of Lean training programs, including Lean 101, Yellowbelt (Level 1), and Greenbelt (Level 2) certifications.
 •Own and facilitate Supervisory Management/ Leadership development, operational assessments, and reliability training programs to drive organizational performance.
 •Facilitate the delivery of a Lean consortium.
 •Customize and tailor to individual manufacturers’ needs for private training delivery upon request with support.
 •Provide Lean program development support to members.
 •Work with the CME Facilitators and partners across the country to ensure methods and messages are consistent.
 •Actively support business development by raising awareness of and filling out CME Training Programs and Workshops.
 •Prepare, own, and deliver CME Sustainable Supplier training.
 •Maintain positive, constructive relationships with all manufacturing members and clients while coaching members on operation excellence best practices. Ensure that the coaching adds value to the members' business operations.
 •Compile and share success stories.
 Other 
 •Support the Lean Champion in the promotion of Lean among Canadian manufacturers.
 •Provide information to prospective CME members on the entire program and services provided by CME.
 •Promote CME events and programs
 •Support and attend CME events as required
 •Actively participate and lead continuous improvement initiatives within CME.
 Qualifications: 
 • Must live in Alberta or be willing to relocate. 
 •Minimum of 5 years Lean Implementation, Planning and Development Maintenance experience.
 •5-7 years of manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
 •Practical experience in leading and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.
 •Adult Instructor/Education certification is an asset.
 • Experience in facilitating Lean and Continuous Improvement initiative in a manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
 •Industry experience in Agriculture, Food processing, oil & gas, metal fabrication, defense, supply chain, or aerospace preferred.
 •Proven project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, manage multiple tasks, and meet strict deadlines; strong attention to detail and the ability to work with colleagues are essential.
 •Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with all stakeholders—internal and external—are essential. A proven ability to build consensus and work effectively within a team is also a plus.
 •Practical experience with capital projects, equipment, and facility commissioning considered an asset.
 •Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
 •Holds a strong desire to uphold CME’s standard for continuous improvement, ethics, and integrity within the CME team and with all outside vendors, clients, and customers.
 •Valid Driver’s License required.
 •Must have the ability to travel to the US.

 Job Description
 Position: Director, Operational Excellence
 Primary Location: This role is offered as a remote position to be home-based, with travel requirements, across either the US or Canada.
 Reports To: VP, Engineering and Operational Excellence
 Compensation: $210,000 -$220,000
Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. More specific salary range for your preferred location can be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, benefits, pension contributions or additional incentives.
Chemtrade is committed to delivering innovative solutions that address the complex challenges faced by our customers. As a responsible corporate citizen, we prioritize safety, sustainability, and environmental stewardship in all aspects of our operations. Our talented and diverse workforce is at the heart of our success, as we recognize that their knowledge, skills, and dedication drive our ability to deliver exceptional products and services. At Chemtrade, we believe in creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents. By putting people at the center of our operations, we build strong connections, nurture innovation, and create a fulfilling work experience for all.
 About This Role And About You
 The Director, Operational Excellence is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of standardized work processes, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, performance measurement systems, and digital tools across the organization. This role serves as the Business Process Owner for key cross-functional workstreams and is accountable for identifying and deploying best practices and enabling technologies that support operational excellence. In partnership with site and functional leaders, the Director will foster a culture of continuous improvement to enhance safety, reliability, productivity, cost performance, and quality.
 Qualifications
 - Post secondary education
 - Minimum 10 years demonstrated experience in Operational Excellence, Quality Systems, Change Management, Continuous Improvement, with at least 5 years of direct operations experience
 - 5-10 years leadership experience
 - Demonstrated success in leading and influencing cross functional teams to effectively drive change and accountability
 - Demonstrated success in leading teams as well as influencing cross functional teams to effectively drive change and accountability
 - Strong organization skills and attention to detail
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills across all levels of the organization
 - Proficiency utilizing computer programs such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project, SAP, Microsoft Teams, Power BI
 - Travel required: Up to 50%
 Responsibilities
 Overall Governance and Strategy
 - Lead the development and implementation of the Operational Excellence strategy across standardized work processes, including Operations, Quality, Continuous Improvement, Employee Experience, Production and Inventory Management, Reliability, and Capital Execution.
 - Identify and leverage technology and tools that improve efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness across standardized work processes.
 - Manage the productivity program, including target identification, performance tracking, organizational alignment, and best-practice sharing to support delivery of results.
 - Promote and embed an Operational Excellence mindset across the organization.
 Business Process Owner
 - Provide leadership and governance for standardized work processes across Operations, Quality, Continuous Improvement, Employee Experience, Production and Inventory Management, Reliability, and Capital Execution.
 - Identify and advance technology opportunities that improve efficiency, effectiveness, and cost performance across key work processes.
 - Own the Change Management Program and support effective adoption of process and system improvements.
 - Develop, enhance, and where applicable, maintain ownership of critical workstreams such as training and SOP document management systems.
 - Leverage data and analytics to identify improvement opportunities and support decision-making
 Operational Excellence Performance
 - Drive accountability and ownership for defined work processes across the organization.
 - Establish standardized key performance indicators across operations to measure performance and support continuous improvement.
 - Develop visual dashboards and analyze performance gaps to identify, prioritize, and support improvement opportunities.
 - Benchmark operational performance internally and, where appropriate, externally to identify leading practices.
 - Facilitate the sharing and adoption of best practices across sites and functions.
 - Use data analytics to monitor results and support operational decision-making.
 Lean Six Sigma
 - Manage the Lean Six Sigma Program: deploying continuous improvement tools (including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, 6S, etc.), Green Belt certification, LSS trainetc. to support operational improvement initiatives.
 - Manage the team to lead cross-functional improvement projects designed to enhance operational performance and business results.
 - Coach, mentor, and train leaders and teams on Lean Six Sigma principles and methodologies.
 - Support initiatives focused on labor efficiency, yield improvement, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
 Member of the Engineering and Operational Excellence Leadership Team
 - Provide leadership to direct reports and establish clear expectations to support achievement of department goals.
 - Provide Operational Excellence leadership, guidance, and accountability to direct reports and key stakeholders, including Master Black Belts, Black Belts, Green Belts, Plant Managers, and Regional Managers/Directors, etc.
 - Collaborate with leadership team members to identify and implement improvement opportunities across the organization.
 - Perform other duties as assigned
 Embracing Diversity, Maximizing Results
At Chemtrade we are committed to cultivating a work environment that embraces and values the unique qualities, skills, and experiences of every employee. We believe in harnessing the richness of diverse talents, ideas, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to drive our business forward, and see our diversity as one of our greatest strengths.
To foster an inclusive environment, we actively encourage the creation of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are open to all employees. These employee-driven groups provide platforms for employees to share their perspectives, contribute their ideas, and help shape our inclusive and respectful culture and provide vital platforms for employees to connect, share experiences, and celebrate their unique backgrounds and perspectives.  - Collaborate with business areas to implement and sustain these tools.

 - Provide guidance and mentorship to Green Belts and Green Belt Candidates to successfully complete improvement projects 
 - Coach departments at all levels (from operator level to senior leadership level) on proper use of the tools 
 - Member of the Business & Operational Excellence Leadership Team 
 - Be an influential leader to drive a culture of continuous improvement with the use of lean six sigma tools 
 - Collaborate with other departmental members to drive improvements within the department 
 - Partner with businesses to facilitate 
 - Be a change leader for the entire Engineering and BOE team

 - Engineering or science degree from an accredited university

 - Demonstrated success in leading cross functional teams 
 - Demonstrated success in driving accountability 
 - Effective change agent 
 - Strong organization skills and attention to detail

 Courtyard.io is one of the fastest-growing collectibles startups. From cards to coins, we’re making it faster, easier, and more exciting than ever to discover, collect, and cash out instantly.
We’re not just another marketplace. With thrilling pack rips, instant liquidity, and seamless vaulting, Courtyard.io delivers the ultimate collecting experience. Whether you’re investing, trading, or curating your dream collection, we’ve built a platform that’s trusted, simple, and built for speed.
And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring across all functions to push the boundaries of what’s possible in collectibles and digital ownership.
 Job Summary
 We’re looking for an Process Improvement Engineer to architect and optimize how Courtyard’s vault and logistics network operates at scale. This role owns the design of workflows, facility layouts, labor models, and material flow across receiving, intake, storage, picking, packing, and shipping. You’ll apply engineering methods, data, and systems thinking to increase throughput, reduce cost per unit, improve accuracy, and support rapid expansion across new vault launches.
You’ll work closely with Vault Operations, Engineering, and Product to translate operational reality into scalable systems, automation, and infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of physical operations and systems design, ensuring Courtyard can grow volume and categories without growing complexity, cost, or risk.
 Person must live within a commutable distance of New Castle, DE
 What You’ll Do
 - Engineer end-to-end workflows across receiving, intake, storage, picking, packing, and shipping to optimize throughput, accuracy, labor efficiency, and space utilization.
 - Define standard operating models and performance benchmarks across vaults.
 - Develop labor standards, capacity models, and staffing plans tied to volume forecasts.
 - Design warehouse and vault layouts, including slotting strategy, workstation design, travel paths, and material flow.
 - Support long-term network planning and new vault design, including throughput modeling and space requirements.
 - Lead operational design for new facility launches from concept through stabilization.
 - Evaluate, model, and implement automation and tooling (scanning workflows, conveyor systems, sortation, robotics, WMS enhancements).
 - Partner with Engineering and Product to design operational systems, data models, and tooling that reflect real-world workflows.
 - Translate operational requirements into technical specifications and system design inputs.
 - Build and analyze operational models to identify bottlenecks, constraints, and cost drivers.
 - Define KPIs and instrumentation to measure flow, productivity, quality, and utilization.
 - Run experiments and pilots to validate improvements before scaling.
 - Lead improvement initiatives from design through implementation and adoption
 - Produce SOPs, training materials, and engineering documentation to support consistency.
 - Act as the technical bridge between operators on the floor and software / product teams.
 What You’ll Bring
 - 5+ years experience in process improvement engineering, industrial engineering, logistics engineering, or similar roles.
 - Hands-on experience in fulfillment centers, warehouses, or logistics networks.
 - Strong foundation in process engineering, workflow design, and operational modeling.
 - Comfort using data to drive decisions (throughput modeling, capacity planning, cost analysis).
 - Experience with warehouse systems, automation, or facility design preferred.
 - Ability to operate at both strategic and ground level—designing systems and validating them on the floor.
 - Strong cross-functional communication skills with technical and non-technical teams.
 - Builder mentality with comfort operating in ambiguity.
 - Experience supporting facility launches, layout design and automation initiatives.
 What You’ll Get In Return
 - A dynamic and engaging environment focused on fostering real growth and innovation
 - Opportunities to create amazing products that our customers truly love and value
 - Comprehensive health insurance packages with dependent coverage
 - Competitive salary with ample opportunities for career advancement and development
 - Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment
 - 401(k) plan with a 4% employer match to help you plan for the future
 - $100 monthly dogfooding stipend to support trying out our products firsthand
 - Access to employee wellness programs designed to support your overall well-being

 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed.  - Quality Assurance: The role includes conducting periodic reviews and validations of process documentation to ensure it reflects actual operations and complies with operational standards. Gathering feedback from stakeholders and operational teams to refine and enhance documentation as necessary is an important responsibility. 
 - Training Support: Collaboration with the training department is essential to align training materials with documented processes, ensuring consistency and accuracy. Assisting in the development of training programs and evaluating their effectiveness, while making recommendations for improvements based on feedback and process changes, is also required. 
 - Documentation Standards: Developing and implementing documentation standards and best practices to ensure consistency and usability across all CX processes is required. Creating and maintaining documentation templates, tools, and resources to facilitate standardized practices is also part of the job. 
 - Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to gather information, clarify process details, and ensure comprehensive documentation is a key responsibility. Engaging with stakeholders to understand their needs and incorporating their feedback into documentation will be essential. 
 - Reporting and Communication: The role involves tracking and reporting progress on documentation projects, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables are of high quality. Clear communication of findings, recommendations, and updates to team members, stakeholders, and management is critical.

 - Experience working with re-engineering tools, methods, and techniques

 What You Should Expect In This Role

 Darauf kannst Du Dich bei uns freuen
 - Zertifizierter TOP-Arbeitgeber: sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem spannenden Umfeld und einem motivierten Team.
 - Zukunftsperspektive: Krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz und realistischer Wachstumsplan.
 - Sinnhaftigkeit: Beitrag zur Energiewende und Stärkung des Handwerks.
 - Stabilität: Die Vorteile des Mittelstands kombiniert mit der Stärke einer internationalen Gruppe.
 - Teamzusammenhalt: Offene, dynamische und ambitionierte Kolleg/innen.
 - Anerkennung: Reale Entwicklungschancen und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten.

  Es gilt: Geschlecht egal. Hauptsache Du passt zu uns!
Deine zukünftige Rolle
Wenn es darum geht, Ziele zu erreichen, bist Du der Champion in der Umsetzung. Als Operational Excellence Manager (m/w/d) erstellst Du strukturierte Pläne, setzt diese mit Entschlossenheit in die Tat um und sorgst mit Blick auf die wichtigen KPIs für eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Arbeitsabläufe - denn nichts ist zu schwer für jemanden, der stets nach Exzellenz strebt. Du hebst unsere Betriebe auf das nächste Level. Konkret bedeutet das:
 - Du gestaltest erstklassige operative Prozesse auf Grundlage Deines Fachwissens und Deiner Expertise.
 - Du beherrscht unterschiedliche Analysetechniken und kennst Dich daher gut mit Datenräumen und Methodik aus.
 - Du unterstützt gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen das Transformationsmanagement und die Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen umzusetzen.
 - Du arbeitest eng mit den Geschäftsführer/innen unserer Betriebe und deren Teams zusammen und förderst als Sparringspartner/in ein harmonisches Zusammenspiel.
 - Du begleitest strategische Sonderprojekte und arbeitest somit aktiv an Verbesserungsprozessen mit.
 - Dein Einsatzgebiet wird der Süden von Deutschland sein. Ab und zu reist du nach Frankfurt in unser Office um Dich mit Deinem Team vor Ort auszutauschen.
 Dein Profil
Mit einem scharfen Auge für Effizienz und Qualität optimierst Du unsere Abläufe und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Handwerksbetriebe stets an der Spitze der Branche stehen. Du bist ein/e echte/r Teamplayer/in, der/die eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammenarbeitet. Deine Fähigkeit, Verbesserungspotentiale zu erkennen und innovative Lösungen zu finden, macht Dich zu einem unverzichtbaren Teil unseres Teams. Bist Du bereit, die Herausforderung anzunehmen und die operative Exzellenz im Handwerk auf ein neues Niveau zu heben? Und konkret hast Du:
 - Du hast eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Meistertitel sowie eine betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation (z.B. Betriebswirt/in, Bachelor in BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar.)
 - Du bringst fundierte Erfahrungen im SHK Bereich mit, in dem Du projektleitend oder in verantwortungsvollen Positionen tätig warst.
 - Deine Stärke liegen im analytischen und selbstständigen Arbeiten sowie einer hohen Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit.
 - Du weißt Dich zu priorisieren und zu strukturieren.
 - Sowohl langfristig angelegt Transformationsmaßnahmen als auch Quick Wins realisierst Du sicher und kommunizierst diese proaktiv.
 - MS 365 Umgebung nutzt Du bereits ganz intuitiv.
 - Nice to have: Du hast keine Scheu Dich auch auf Englisch zu verständigen.
 Über uns
HomeServe wurde vor mehr als 30 Jahren in Großbritannien gegründet und ist heute einer der weltweit führenden Dienstleister im Bereich Sanitär, Heizung und Klima (SHK) und Elektro mit einem Umsatz von ca. 100 Millionen Euro. Seit 2022 bieten wir inzwischen über 1.500 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland die Chance, unsere Unternehmenskultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Mit ca. 100 Kolleg/innen in unserem Servicecenter in Frankfurt sind wir die Ansprechpartner unserer SHK-Betriebe.
Als deutschlandweite Handwerksgruppe mit regional starken und eigenständischen Betrieben sind wir stolz darauf, technisch die Nase vorn zu haben. Mit traditionellem Handwerk und modernster Technologie sorgen wir dafür, dass sich unsere Kunden in ihrem Zuhause wohlfühlen. Gemeinsam haben wir zum Ziel, die Zukunft des Handwerks zu sichern und zur Energiewende beizutragen. Du möchtest die Zukunft der SHK-Branche mit uns gestalten? Machen statt Reden ist Dein Motto? Das Ergebnis Deiner Arbeit macht Dich stolz? Dann komm in unser Team!
Erlebe, was HomeServe so besonders macht: Die Menschen, die Leidenschaft und die Vision, die uns antreiben.
Wirf einen Blick hinter die Kulissen !
Wir sind HomeServe – Wir sind Handwerk mit Zukunft!

 - Reisetätigkeit: ca. 60%

 Job Description
 Operational Excellence Consultant
 At Honeywell Aerospace, we solve the toughest challenges in aviation and deliver innovations that shape the future of flight. From advanced propulsion and avionics to integrated systems and services, our technologies help keep aircraft flying safely, efficiently, and sustainably. Come join our team of world‑changing thinkers, doers, dreamers, and makers.
The Honeywell Aerospace Operating System (AOS) is our enterprise‑wide Lean operating model, grounded in respect for people and a relentless commitment to continuous improvement. AOS provides the standardized processes, tools, and behaviors that empower teams to solve problems, eliminate waste, and deliver with consistency and excellence across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and program execution.
Honeywell is progressing through an exciting AOS transformation journey—moving from foundational adoption to deeper integration, cultural maturity, and consistent execution across the global Aerospace organization. This work is strengthening collaboration, operational discipline, and performance at every level.
As an Operational Excellence Consultant, you will play a vital role in this evolution. You will help teams make an impact, make real connections, and make the best version of themselves—driving meaningful improvements, coaching AOS behaviors, and enabling Honeywell Aerospace to climb higher, together.
As an Operational Excellence Consultant here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be a critical leader in the development and enterprise-wide deployment for the Aerospace Operating System (AOS), driving the transformation of operational performance across the business.
You will partner closely with site level AOS leaders and business stakeholders to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and enable scalable implementation across functions including Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), R&D, and Commercial.
As the key thought leader and change agent, this individual will coach leaders, drive method development and continuous improvement initiatives, and optimize end-to-end business and supply chain processes spanning procurement, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
This position may be performed remotely; however, travel is required up to 75%.
 Responsibilities
 Key Responsibilities:
 - Support & coach AOS Leaders to drive overall AOS roll-out of unit, set-up implementation roadmap and coordinate transition activities in the unit
 - Collaborate with the AOS Leader and align with the Head of Unit on their priorities and plans to achieve operational, financial, and strategic targets 
 - Actively supports AOS Agile Action Plan(s) to deliver on Performance Improvement targets of units
 - Create impact through facilitation of training courses and Kaizen Improvement Events 
 - Qualify & coach AOS Key Enablers on AOS Methods and the Lean Six Sigma mindset 
 - Drives AOS Method development and improvement in a focus area of expertise, e.g. ISC, R&D or Commercial 
 - Act as AOS thought leader for cultural change
 - Lead and manage strategic and tactical change projects, ensuring effective planning, execution, and delivery.
 - Apply Lean Management–based business systems (such as DBS, HOS, and the Toyota Production System) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
 - Conduct process and management consulting to identify improvement opportunities and optimize business workflows.
 - Communicate effectively across the organization, collaborating with stakeholders in both the local language and English.
 - Lead Supply Chain Excellence Initiatives: Drive the end-to-end supply chain Honeywell Manufacturing Excellence Roadmap, executing initiatives related to demand planning, procurement, production planning, inventory management, and logistics optimization.
 - Support Strategy Deployment: Collaborate with the site leadership team to deploy strategies effectively, establishing and coaching critical initiatives (A3’s), Tier accountability processes, and leading GEMBA walks to enhance structured problem-solving techniques.
 - Digital Transformation and Innovation: Identify and oversee initiatives aimed at implementing digitalization, data analytics, and process optimization across all supply chains, driving efficiencies and best practices.
 - Continuous Improvement Collaboration: Work alongside cross-functional teams to initiate and sustain continuous improvement initiatives, actively reducing waste while implementing innovative practices.
 - Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze key supply chain performance metrics to pinpoint areas for improvement, reinforcing corrective actions where necessary.
 - Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and company policies to maintain operational integrity and excellence.
 Qualifications
 YOU MUST HAVE:
 - A minimum of 8 years of experience, with more than 4 years of leadership experience with Lean Manufacturing, Lean Business Systems, Consultancy or Operational Excellence.
 - Willingness and ability to travel up to 75% for business needs.
 - 4 or more years of relevant leadership experience in Lean manufacturing, Lean supply chain, or strategic change projects. 
 - Master Practitioner level of competency in the fundamental Lean tools
 - Hands on experience in organizing and conducting Kaizen events and improvement workshops, coaching, and supporting change initiatives. 
 - Strong expertise in Lean manufacturing, with a proven track record of implementation and change management.
 - Demonstrated people leadership experience in providing guidance, coaching, and mentoring direct and/or indirect reports.
 - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach.
 - Ability to inspire change & influence without authority.
 - Results and quality orientation.
 - Familiarity with ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) systems and other relevant software solutions.
 - Comprehensive knowledge of industry best practices, emerging trends, and technologies within supply chain management.
 - Due to US export control laws, candidates must be U.S. citizen, perm resident, protected status under asylum/refugee, OR can obtain export approval.
 We Value
 - A Bachelor’s degree in Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.. Master’s of Business Administration is preferred.
 - Strong leadership qualities, capable of inspiring and uniting teams towards common goals.
 - A proven history of driving operational excellence and delivering substantial results.
 - The ability to effectively juggle multiple priorities while consistently meeting deadlines.
 - Robust problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with a strong focus on operational efficiencies.
 - A continuous improvement mindset complemented by a genuine passion for driving positive change.
 The annual base salary range for this position in California and New York (excluding most major metropolitan areas), Colorado, Connecticut, and Hawaii is $186,000-$232,000. For Washington and most major metropolitan areas in New York & California, the annual base salary range is $213,900-$266,800. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 paid Holidays. For more information visit: Benefits at Honeywell
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
Honeywell (NASDAQ: HON) is spinning off its Aerospace Technologies business into a new, independent publicly traded company – Honeywell Aerospace Inc. (Nasdaq: HONA) – to create the world’s leading pure-play aerospace supplier. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the independent company will focus on enhancing flight technology, including propulsion, cockpit systems, and auxiliary power, with a heavy emphasis on high-margin aftermarket services. The separation of Honeywell Aerospace, on June 29, 2026, will have greater strategic focus and financial flexibility to pursue organic and inorganic growth opportunities, serving as a primary provider to the commercial and defense aviation industries.
Honeywell Aerospace is a global leader in mission critical aerospace and defense technologies, offering candidates the opportunity to join a high growth, innovation driven organization. With approximately $17 billion in net sales and a strong $18 billion total backlog, Aerospace operates from a position of financial strength and long term stability. The business reinvests roughly 10% of its sales into R&D each year, fueling advancements in electrification, autonomy, safety, and next generation aviation systems.
Our team of more than 32,000 employees drives innovation across a portfolio protected by around 9,000 active patents. With over 90 engineering, manufacturing, and MRO facilities worldwide, Aerospace offers opportunities to work on complex, high impact technologies and collaborate with global teams shaping the future of flight. Joining Honeywell Aerospace means becoming part of a purpose driven organization with the scale, resources, and technical strength to innovate at speed — and the culture to support your growth and career development.

 As a Process Improvement Engineer at CenterWell, you will lead initiatives to optimize operational efficiency, elevate the patient experience, and drive measurable cost savings across CenterWell. The ideal candidate blends industrial engineering principles with a deep understanding of healthcare operations.
The Process Improvement Lead researches best business practices within and outside the organization to establish benchmark data. Collects and analyzes process data to initiate, develop and recommend business practices and procedures that focus on enhanced safety, increased productivity and reduced cost. Determines how new information technologies can support re-engineering business processes. May specialize in one or more of the following areas: benchmarking, business process analysis and re-engineering, change management and measurement, and/or process-driven systems requirements. Advises executives to develop functional strategies (often segment specific) on matters of significance. Exercises independent judgment and decision making on complex issues regarding job duties and related tasks, and works under minimal supervision, Uses independent judgment requiring analysis of variable factors and determining the best course of action.
 Key Responsibilities
 - Own and deliver a portfolio of process improvement projects that collectively achieve significant, quantifiable annual cost savings and ROI/NPV targets.
 - Lead rapid-improvement (Kaizen) events and large-scale transformation programs that produce measurable outcomes in safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
 - Accurately define, quantify, validate, and report financial impact (hard savings, soft savings, ROI, NPV) of all initiatives.
 - Influence executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners without formal authority through data-driven insights and compelling storytelling.
 - Advanced problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.
 - Leverage process mapping, statistical analysis (Minitab, JMP), visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI), and SQL to uncover root causes and validate solutions.

 Use your skills to make an impact

 - Proven experience developing and implementing cost-saving frameworks and operational dashboards.
 - Proficiency in process mapping, statistical analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

 Preferred Qualifications
 - Direct experience within Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), Pharmacy, Retail Clinics and Home Health
 - Master Black Belt certification

 This is a senior advisory opportunity for an experienced executive who can help a growing organisation strengthen leadership effectiveness and improve operational performance at the same time. Working closely with the CEO and executive team, you will support better decision-making, stronger cross-functional alignment, and more disciplined execution across the business.
 Important scope clarification: this is not an appointment as Chief Executive Officer. It is a senior advisory role focused on operational excellence, executive coaching, and leadership support within an existing executive structure.
 The Client or Stakeholder Problem You’ll Help Solve 
 Our client is a dynamic, growth-focused organisation operating in an environment where leadership quality and operational discipline both matter. As the business scales, senior leaders need a trusted advisor who can help them sharpen leadership capability, improve team effectiveness, and identify practical ways to strengthen operational performance
 .This role is designed for someone who can bridge executive coaching with operational improvement, helping the CEO and leadership team move from ambition to aligned execution.
 Why Your Background Matters 
 Your experience in VP, C-suite, or equivalent senior leadership roles will be valuable because this role requires credibility with senior decision-makers. You will be engaging leaders who need thoughtful challenge, practical guidance, and support in translating strategy into day-to-day organisational performance.
 If you have led operational initiatives, improved business performance, coached senior stakeholders, or supported organisational change in complex environments, your background may be especially relevant he re. 
 What You’ll Be Trusted T o Do
 - Provide one-to-one coaching and structured guidance to senior leaders and executive stakeholders
 - Support leadership teams in improving collaboration, decision-making, and overall leadership effectiveness
 - Advise the CEO and executive team on operational excellence priorities that can improve efficiency, alignment, and sustainable growth
 - Work with senior management to identify opportunities to strengthen processes, reduce operational friction, and support strategic execution
 - Contribute insight on organisational performance, talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives
 - Support cross-functional improvement efforts across areas such as operations, finance, HR, and compliance alignment, while working within the scope of an advisory role
 - Help leadership stakeholders recognise and act on market, organisational, and operational opportunities
 - Foster strong internal partnerships that support both business performance and a high-performing, inclusive cul ture 
 Who Benefits From Your Work 
 Your work will directly support the CEO, senior leadership team, and cross-functional business leaders. Indirectly, it will benefit the wider organisation by helping leadership teams operate more effectively and by improving the systems and operating rhythms that support gr o wth.
 What Success Looks Like 
 Success in this role is likely to include:
 - stronger executive decision-making
 - more effective leadership collaboration
 - clearer operational priorities and improved execution discipline
 - practical improvements in efficiency and organisational alignment
 - stronger support for sustainable growth and business perfo rmance 
 What We’re Looking For 
 - Significant experience in VP, C-suite, or equivalent senior leadership roles
 - Demonstrated success in operational strategy, organisational improvement, or business performance leadership
 - Strong executive coaching, mentoring, or leadership development capability
 - Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders credibly
 - Strong business judgment and understanding of strategy, operations, and leadership effectiveness
 - Experience working across complex or cross-functional business environments
 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field
 - Advanced degree such as a Master’s or Doctorate is welcomed but not essential
 - Legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom
 Experience That Would Be Especially Valuable

 - business operations leadership

 - technology, professional services, banking, or other scaling organisations
 Equivalent experience will also be considered where it demonstrates strong executive credibility, coaching capability, and operational impact.
 What Makes This Opportunity Attractive

 - The chance to contribute meaningfully within a forward-looking and growth-oriented or ganisation

 Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in public administration, public policy, business, organizational development, industrial engineering, operations management, design, human factors, or a related field. 
 - Five or more years of professional experience in human-centered design, process improvement, service design, operational excellence, organizational transformation, or consulting, preferably in government, public sector, or other highly regulated environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience applying human-centered design methods such as user interviews, journey mapping, service blueprinting, co-design, synthesis, prototyping, and iterative testing to improve services and operations.

 - Certification in human-centered design, design thinking, service design, or a comparable discipline from a recognized program. 
 - Certification or formal training in business process mapping, Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN, business process management, or related continuous improvement methodologies. 
 - Experience leading organizational change initiatives tied to process redesign, service modernization, digital transformation, operating model change, or enterprise improvement efforts. 
 - Experience developing and executing change management strategies that support stakeholder alignment, communications, training, adoption, resistance management, and sustainment. 
 - Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, program teams, frontline staff, policy owners, and technical teams. 
 - Ability to translate complex workflows, research findings, and operational issues into clear recommendations, visual artifacts, and implementation plans.

 What this job involves: The Operational Excellence Manager is responsible for driving continuous improvement, standardization, and capability building within our operations team. This role serves as a critical bridge between strategic operational goals and frontline execution. The primary focus is to enhance service delivery quality through rigorous training programs, the development of standardized best practices and tools, and act as floating PFM during PFM turnover or transition periods in APAC.
The Operational Excellence Manager reports to the Regional Workplace Coordinator for North Asia Pacific. While primary locations include Canberra, Singapore, Beijing, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Manila, Jakarta, and Bangkok, we are open to candidates based in other locations within the region.
 PFM without portfolio
 - Step in as the acting PFM during planned or unplanned absences of site leads to ensure zero disruption in service delivery. 
 - Provide direct supervision and guidance to on-site technical and soft services teams during coverage periods, ensuring adherence to safety , compliance, and performance standards. 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during coverage periods, managing expectations, attending key meetings and resolving escalated issues promptly. 
 - Monitor Work Order management within the Corrigo system to ensure proactive planning and vendor coordination. Verify correct task assignment and drive timely completion or escalation of issues prior to due dates to maintain service level agreements. 
 - Conduct comprehensive operational diagnostics to assess on-ground realities, including team structure, task allocation, communication dynamics, workplace culture, and vendor/contract management. Collaborate with RFMs and RWLs to translate these insights into actionable, long-term continuous improvement plans. 
 Drive and lead operational excellence
 - Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures for critical operational activities, ensuring consistency across all sites. 
 - Identify opportunities for process optimization and tool enhancement. Lead initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce waste, and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Track and report on key operational KPIs and use data-driven insights to drive decision-making and corrective actions. 
 - Lead and own the Operational Excellence components of the annual Account Development Plan to implement transformative changes and drive continuous service enhancement. 
 - Support RFMs and Site Teams in monitoring operational expenditures. Identify cost-saving opportunities through process optimization, vendor consolidation, or energy efficiency initiatives, ensuring operational activities align with the account’s financial goals. 
 - Establish and maintain a centralized Knowledge Management repository for SOPs, training materials, and best practice case studies. Ensure this resource is easily accessible and regularly updated to serve as a single source of truth for the operations team. 
 - Serve as a liaison between PFMs, regional leadership, and clients by understanding their unique pain points and concerns. Translate this feedback into actionable solutions that promote cross-functional collaboration and resolve operational bottlenecks. 
 Operational Trainings
 - Design and deliver targeted training programs based on gaps identified during operational reviews. Focus on technical skills, soft skills, contract and vendor management and effective communication. 
 - Provide ongoing coaching to site teams and emerging leaders. Foster a culture of continuous learning and accountability. 
 - Revamp and manage the onboarding process for new hires alongside line managers, ensuring rapid integration into the team and immediate understanding of operational standards and cultural expectations. 
 - Maintain a skills matrix for the operations team. Create personalized development plans to address individual and team-wide competency gaps. 
 - Lead change management initiatives when rolling out new processes, technologies, or organizational structures. Act as a change agent to overcome resistance, ensure staff adoption of new standards, and communicate the benefits of operational improvements to all stakeholders. 
 Requirements:
 - Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in Facilities Management, Operations, or Continuous Improvement roles. 
 - Proven track record in designing and delivering training programs. 
 - Experience with multi-site operations or floating resource models is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of FM operational workflows in client account and industry standards. 
 - Excellent presentation, public speaking, and coaching skills. 
 - Proficiency in process mapping tools (e.g., Visio) and data analysis (Excel, Power BI). 
 - Change management expertise with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. 
 - Microsoft Office and knowledge of relevant software.

 James Hardie is the industry leader in exterior home and outdoor living solutions, with a portfolio that includes fiber cement, fiber gypsum, composite and PVC decking and railing products. Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®.
With over 8,000 employees and our U.S. operating entities headquartered in Chicago, we boast 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we’re united by our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™ through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities.
For more information, visit www.jameshardie.com.
 Summary
 Reporting to the North American Lean Leader, the Central Lean Manager is responsible for leading and supporting Lean transformation across multiple North American manufacturing sites. This role partners directly with plant leadership teams to build Lean capability, strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and create sustainable systems that enable safe, predictable, and profitable growth. The Central Lean Manager serves as a coach, change leader, and strategic business partner who helps sites embed the Hardie Manufacturing Operating System (HMOS) into daily work. This position may be based at a plant location or at the corporate office in Chicago. Travel is expected to range from 25% to 75%, depending on location and business needs.
 What You’ll Do:
 The Central Lean Manager leads through influence across a matrixed manufacturing environment, focusing on:
 Lean Strategy & Deployment
 - Partner with plant and functional leaders to translate business priorities into targeted Lean roadmaps. 
 - Deploy HMOS standards, routines, and systems across sites. 
 - Align Lean initiatives to measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and engagement. 
 - Use data and observation to prioritize high-impact improvement opportunities. 
 Daily Management & Standard Work
 - Coach sites on Daily Management Systems, including tiered meetings, visual management, and escalation routines. 
 - Strengthen operator and leader standard work to improve consistency and sustain results. 
 - Reinforce use of gemba walks, layered verification, and coaching routines. 
 - Ensure Lean systems are practical, visible, and owned by site leadership. 
 Kaizen & Problem Solving
 - Lead and coach Kaizen (VOO) events that address critical business challenges. 
 - Manage the improvement funnel from opportunity identification through sustainment. 
 - Build capability in structured problem solving (PDCA, root cause analysis, A3, 5 Whys). 
 - Deliver measurable results with clear ownership and follow-up actions. 
 Coaching & Capability Building
 - Teach and mentor leaders and teams in Lean principles and HMOS standards. 
 - Develop leader capability in proactive process management and coaching. 
 - Build self-sufficiency at sites to sustain improvements independently. 
 - Facilitate learning through hands-on coaching, training, and workshops. 
 Change Management & Sustainment
 - Lead change through stakeholder alignment, engagement, and clear communication. 
 - Remove barriers and address systemic issues to drive adoption. 
 - Establish sustainment mechanisms to maintain standards and performance. 
 - Share and adapt best practices across sites. 
 Business Results & Performance Management
 - Measure and report Lean impact using operational and financial metrics. 
 - Link improvement activity to key outcomes (safety, quality, cost, productivity, etc.). 
 - Support planning processes by identifying Lean-driven opportunities. 
 - Track leading and lagging indicators to assess adoption and effectiveness. 
 What You’ll Bring:
 - 7+ years of progressive experience in Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or manufacturing leadership, including at least 5 years leading cross-functional improvement initiatives or transformation efforts in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Strong practical application of Lean principles, including daily management, standard work, visual management, 5S, Kaizen, structured problem solving, and strategy deployment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach, influence, and build capability across all levels of the organization, from frontline operators to senior leadership, within a complex, matrixed environment. 
 - Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to drive alignment across functions, sites, and stakeholders. 
 - Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to connect continuous improvement activities to operational and financial performance. 
 - Proven ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and deliver results in dynamic, resource-constrained environments. 
 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, business, supply chain, or a related field preferred; advanced degree (e.g., MBA or Master’s) is a plus. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification or equivalent transformation experience preferred. 
 - Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations and leading Lean maturity assessments, Daily Management Systems, and leader/operator standard work is desirable. 
 What You’ll Receive:
 As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is $114,000K to $135,000K. Placement in the range depends on several factors such as experience, skills, geography and internal equity and may change over time. This position qualifies for benefits and you will be eligible to participate in a bonus plan.
At James Hardie, we recognize that our success depends on our people. We've worked hard to build a generous and competitive benefits program that demonstrates our commitment to our employees.

 - Insurance: day-one health coverage medical, dental, vision, life insurance
 - Paid Time Off: vacation and company holidays
 - Retirement: 401(k) with 6% match
 - Investments: Employee Stock Purchase plan (ESP)
 - Work-Life Balance: parental leave, wellness programs

 This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Process Improvement Project Analyst Principal based in United States.
 This role offers the opportunity to lead enterprise-level transformation initiatives that improve operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational effectiveness.
The Process Improvement Project Analyst Principal will drive complex process improvement programs using Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven analysis, and change leadership practices.
Working closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams, this position will identify opportunities, design future-state processes, and deliver measurable business impact.
The role plays a key part in building a culture of continuous improvement by establishing best practices, coaching teams, and advancing operational excellence capabilities.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced transformation leader who thrives on solving complex challenges and creating sustainable organizational change.
The position provides the chance to influence strategy, improve healthcare operations, and shape scalable solutions within a purpose-driven environment.
 Accountabilities
 The Process Improvement Project Analyst Principal will serve as a strategic leader responsible for driving large-scale process transformation initiatives, improving organizational capabilities, and delivering measurable outcomes. This role combines operational excellence expertise, stakeholder influence, and analytical problem-solving to create sustainable improvements across the organization.
 - Lead enterprise-wide and highly complex cross-functional transformation initiatives using Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.
 - Identify process improvement opportunities, define future-state operating models, and deliver measurable financial, operational, customer, and employee outcomes.
 - Partner with senior and executive leaders to shape strategic decisions, align stakeholders, and drive successful transformation efforts.
 - Establish and maintain continuous improvement standards, frameworks, tools, dashboards, reporting structures, and value measurement practices.
 - Develop and execute improvement strategies that support operational maturity, scalability, and long-term business performance.
 - Apply healthcare, industry, and operational insights to identify emerging opportunities and influence strategic priorities.
 - Mentor and coach process improvement professionals and business partners in Lean Six Sigma methods, project execution, facilitation, and change leadership.
 - Build organizational capabilities through training, governance, knowledge sharing, and advancement of continuous improvement practices.
 - Use advanced analytics, data visualization, and business insights to validate root causes, measure results, and guide decision-making.
 - Support enterprise change initiatives by promoting adoption, sustainability, and long-term benefit realization.
 - Perform additional responsibilities as needed to support organizational goals.
 Requirements
 The ideal candidate is an experienced process improvement leader with strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and a proven ability to influence enterprise-level change. This role requires expertise in Lean Six Sigma, transformation management, stakeholder engagement, and data-driven decision-making.
 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 - 7+ years of experience in process improvement, Lean Six Sigma, business analysis, operational excellence, or project management.
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification required.
 - Experience leading complex enterprise and cross-functional transformation initiatives.
 - Strong ability to analyze ambiguous business challenges, establish solutions, and deliver measurable improvements.
 - Advanced proficiency in data analysis, statistics, visualization, and translating insights into business actions.
 - Excellent executive communication, facilitation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across diverse teams.
 - Strong coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing continuous improvement capabilities.
 - Strategic thinker with strong business judgment, systems thinking, and change leadership skills.
 - Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, regulated industries, or large-scale operational environments preferred.
 - Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
 - Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification is a plus.
 - Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent advanced project/program management certification preferred.
 - Experience with automation, artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, process mining, business intelligence, or advanced data science tools is beneficial.
 - Experience building enterprise continuous improvement programs, centers of excellence, or operational excellence frameworks is preferred.
 - Familiarity with organizational change management methodologies such as Prosci or ADKAR is a plus.
 - Must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring work visa or residency sponsorship.
 Benefits

 - Remote work opportunity with flexibility.
 - Comprehensive benefits package including healthcare coverage and employee support programs.
 - Retirement and financial wellness benefits.
 - Opportunities for professional growth, leadership development, and continuous learning.
 - Ability to work on impactful transformation initiatives that improve healthcare operations.
 - Collaborative environment focused on innovation, purpose, and operational excellence.
 - Opportunities to influence enterprise strategy and develop organizational capabilities.

In this context, the Operational Excellence Consultant acts as an inhouse consultant, leading end‑to‑end improvement initiatives from problem identification and root‑cause analysis through to solution design and implementation

 - A flexible working policy.
 - A strong focus on diversity, inclusion and equal opportunities.
 - A role with impact.

 Job Description
 The Loan Underwriting Analyst position will perform underwriting due diligence reviews of loans for residential care facilities, assisted living facilities, and skilled-nursing facilities in support of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD's) Office of Healthcare Programs.
 Responsibilities
 - Review, analyze, or conduct underwriting due diligence for residential healthcare facilities to include review of: 
 - Appraisals of residential healthcare facilities, 
 - Physical condition reports of residential healthcare facilities, 
 - Credit histories and determining credit worthiness of multifamily borrowers, operators, and/or management agents, 
 - Financial statements of properties and participants, 
 - Quality of care issues/professional liability insurance in residential healthcare facilities. 
 - Review new and renewal loan applications to facilitate and ensure their compliance with HUD's lending guidance per the Multifamily handbook

 - Excellent analytical skills and technical writing skills (including grammar, editing, and proofreading skills to draft underwriting narratives and loan committee packages) 
 - Ability to prioritize tasks with strong time management skills 
 - Strong organizational skills 
 - Work productively and accurately in a fast-paced environment with multiple projects and stringent deadlines. 
 - Organized and detail oriented 
 - Critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Accepting 1099 contractors

 Must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for work visa or residency sponsorship

 - Proven ability to build organizational capability through coaching, mentoring, training, governance, and advancement of Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement practices
 - Recognized thought leader with exceptional business acumen, systems thinking, and the ability to identify strategic opportunities, mitigate enterprise risks, and drive sustainable organizational change
 Preferred Qualifications

 - Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), healthcare, highly regulated industry, or large-scale operational excellence experience.
 - Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification
 - Project Management Professional certification or equivalent advanced project/program management certification, with experience leading large-scale technology, digital transformation, or enterprise system implementation initiatives.
 - Advanced expertise in statistical analysis, predictive analytics, process mining, data science, business intelligence, automation, artificial intelligence, and data visualization to drive business decisions and operational performance
 - Experience developing, governing, and scaling enterprise continuous improvement programs, operating models, or centers of excellence, including the development, delivery, and certification of Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and Black Belt training programs

This role partners closely with HR Operations leadership, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Accounting, IT, and HRIS to deliver consistent, reliable, and high-quality HR services across multiple countries and systems.

 Lead and Develop the P&C Operations Team (40%)

 - Drive team performance by enhancing processes, removing barriers, and enabling efficient, employee centered service delivery.

 Opportunity

 - Lead highly technical and complex problem solving.

 - Travel to sites and coach in the Gemba.

 - Experience leading and coaching lean in product and process development. 
 - Experience coaching lean practices in engineering, technical and transactional (administrative) environments. 
 - Proven expertise coaching Value Stream Mapping, Visual Management, A3 Problem Solving, TPM/OEE, SMED, 2P/3P, Standard Work, line balancing, quality improvement tools, Cell design, Kanban, Waste identification and 5S.

 - Bachelor’s degree
 - Minimum of 15+ years Lean Experience, leading and coaching in operations and technical environment

 Job Purpose 
 The Continuous Improvement Manager leads efforts to improve plant and business performance through Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, Total Productive Maintenance, root cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving. This role partners with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to reduce waste, improve equipment reliability, strengthen processes, and support sustainable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, staffing, training, and automation.
 Key Responsibilities and Duties 
 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives aligned with plant, department, and company goals.
 - Partner with operations, maintenance, engineering, quality, HR, training, safety, and other departments to identify and implement improvement opportunities across the business.
 - Drive plant-level improvements in waste reduction, throughput, downtime, labor efficiency, staffing effectiveness, training optimization, automation implementation, and overall operational performance.
 - Facilitate Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and structured problem-solving sessions.
 - Implement and support Lean tools such as 5S, standard work, visual management, value stream mapping, and process mapping.
 - Support implementation of Total Productive Maintenance practices to improve equipment reliability, reduce unplanned downtime, and strengthen preventive and autonomous maintenance processes.
 - Utilize and coach teams on root cause analysis tools, including 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, Pareto analysis, and corrective action planning.
 - Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators such as scrap rate, OEE, downtime, cycle time, labor efficiency, and throughput.
 - Train and coach frontline employees, supervisors, managers, and cross-functional teams on Lean, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement practices.
 - Conduct classroom and floor-side mentoring to build problem-solving capability and reinforce sustainable improvements.
 - Influence culture change by helping teams move from reactive troubleshooting to proactive, data-informed process ownership.
 - Share best practices across locations and help standardize successful processes where appropriate.
 - Track project progress, verify effectiveness of corrective actions, and follow up to ensure improvements are sustained.
 - Prepare updates, reports, and presentations on project status, performance trends, and improvement results.
 - Perform all other duties as assigned.
 Experience and Educational Qualifications 
 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field preferred.
 - Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing experience required.
 - Experience leading continuous improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment required.
 - Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
 - Experience facilitating Kaizen events, root cause analysis, process mapping, and structured problem-solving activities preferred.
 - Experience coaching or training employees on Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, or continuous improvement tools preferred.
 Abilities Required 
 - Strong understanding of Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, standard work, 5S, value stream mapping, visual management, and continuous improvement principles.
 - Ability to analyze data, identify trends, evaluate performance gaps, and recommend practical solutions.
 - Strong root cause analysis, coaching, facilitation, training, and communication skills.
 - Ability to influence others and drive change without direct authority.
 - Ability to work effectively with frontline employees, supervisors, plant leadership, and corporate support teams.
 - Strong project management, follow-up, and organizational skills.
 - Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment and spending time on the production floor.
 - Must be able to come to work promptly and regularly, take direction, work well with others, meet deadlines, perform accurately, react to change productively, and handle other tasks as assigned.

 Operational Excellence Manager 
 Position Summary 
 Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Operational Excellence (OpEx) Manager is responsible for executing strategic initiatives and advancing organizational capabilities in support of Nadler Modular’s Operational Excellence program. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to implement operational improvements that enhance quality, productivity, labor efficiency, and cost optimization.
 The OpEx Manager serves as a key change agent, fostering a culture rooted in safety, accountability, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement. This position plays a critical role in establishing scalable, sustainable, and best-in-class operational practices across the organization.
 The role includes leading performance analysis, conducting gap assessments, identifying improvement opportunities, and driving the implementation of process enhancements across critical business functions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Champion the deployment of operational best practices across all business segments.
 - Lead cross-functional initiatives to map processes, analyze performance data, and identify root causes of operational challenges.
 - Design and implement process improvement solutions that drive measurable gains in efficiency, customer satisfaction, product quality, and overall profitability.
 - Develop and manage a monthly KPI reporting framework, including analysis, issue identification, and actionable improvement plans.
 - Serve as a change agent by promoting cultural transformation and driving the adoption of new tools, techniques, and operational methodologies.
 - Facilitate cross-training initiatives to strengthen organizational capability, promote knowledge sharing, and enhance team performance.
 - Develop, maintain, and ensure compliance with procedures, standards, and metrics related to quality, safety, productivity, and operational effectiveness.
 Professional and Cultural Attributes 
 - Strong business acumen with a strategic and results-oriented mindset. Collaborative, team-focused approach with the ability to work effectively across functional boundaries.
 - Exceptional ability to translate complex data and processes into clear, concise, and actionable insights.
 - Demonstrated ability to lead change initiatives, challenge the status quo, and drive continuous improvement with persistence and accountability.
 - High level of integrity and ethical standards; operates with honesty, transparency, and professionalism.
 - Strong executive presence, with attention to detail, accuracy, and overall quality of work.
 Education

 Experience and Qualifications

 Additional Requirements

 Work Environment
