 Signaler cette offre d’emploi
 Duetto is building its quality engineering function from scratch — and this is the first hire that will define what quality engineering means across the organisation. This isn't a traditional QA gatekeeper role: developers own testing at Duetto, and you'll be the person who coaches, enables, and builds the shared infrastructure that makes high-quality testing the path of least resistance. The timing is significant — a live monolith-to-microservices migration, a frontend migration to Playwright, and a shift to AI-generated code at scale. Each demands someone who can design test strategy for a system in motion.
 What Makes Us Different? 
 Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 - You'll define and own quality gate logic within CI pipelines — coverage thresholds, mutation score gates, contract test enforcement, flaky test quarantine rules, and test result reporting — and build DataDog quality dashboards tracking test health, coverage trends, and flaky test rates across the engineering organisation.
 - You'll lead and execute the migration from Selenium and Cypress to consolidated Playwright (currently 26% complete), using Claude Code to accelerate AI-assisted test migration at scale — designing the shared Playwright configuration, CI sharding strategy, and page object library, and consolidating from three E2E frameworks to one.
 - You'll design and implement Pact contract testing for service boundaries created during the monolith-to-microservices extraction — managing the Pact broker, establishing consumer-driven contract testing as standard practice, and owning API contract testing for GraphQL and REST service contracts.
 - You'll design and maintain Testcontainers configurations for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, LocalStack, and RabbitMQ, and drive PR pipeline test execution toward the P90 target of under 15 minutes.
 - You'll champion AI-augmented testing practices using Claude Code, CodeRabbit, and Augment — evaluating and reviewing AI-generated test code for correctness and coverage gaps in a codebase where 50–70% of code is already AI-generated.
 - You'll coach developers on testing practices and automation patterns, establish mutation testing using PIT (Java) and Stryker (JavaScript/TypeScript), and mentor junior QEs as the quality engineering function grows.
 What We're Looking For 
 You may be a good fit if you have: 
 - Strong experience with Playwright for end-to-end test automation, including page object patterns and CI integration
 - Hands-on experience defining and implementing quality gates within GitHub Actions pipelines
 - Contract testing experience — Pact experience strongly preferred
 - Proficiency in both Java and TypeScript/JavaScript for test implementation
 - Experience with Testcontainers or equivalent integration test infrastructure
 - Demonstrated ability to reduce test flakiness at scale
 - Strong understanding of test strategy for distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
 - Active experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants for test generation and automation — you understand that AI-generated code requires a different quality practice, not a lighter one
 Strong candidates may also have: 
 - Experience migrating legacy E2E frameworks (Selenium, Cypress) to Playwright at scale
 - Familiarity with mutation testing tools — PIT for Java, Stryker for JavaScript/TypeScript
 - Experience with performance testing using k6
 - Background in hospitality technology or complex B2B SaaS environments
 Why Duetto? 
 - You'll build something that doesn't exist yet. This is the first senior QE hire at Duetto — the practices, infrastructure, and standards you establish will shape how the entire engineering organisation approaches quality for years.
 - AI-first testing, for real. With 50–70% of code AI-generated and Claude Code already in the daily workflow, you'll be pioneering what quality engineering looks like when the code generation model fundamentally changes — not theorising about it.
 - Architectural impact at scale. The monolith-to-microservices migration is live, the Playwright migration is underway, and the contract testing infrastructure needs building — the problems are real, the timing is right, and the infrastructure you design matters.
 - Modern tooling throughout. Playwright, Testcontainers, Pact, k6, GitHub Actions, DataDog — no legacy constraints holding you back.
 - A clear growth path. Senior QE (L5) to Staff/Lead QE (L6) as the quality engineering function matures and grows.
 The Details 
 - Location: Remote (Croatia)
 - Team: Quality Engineering
 Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 Sound like you? 
 You don't need a hospitality background. If you're a quality engineer with strong automation and contract testing chops, a coaching mindset, and the drive to build a function from the ground up in an AI-first engineering culture — we'd love to hear from you.

You will play a critical role in bringing new products from design to mass production by defining and deploying testing capabilities locally, reducing dependency on external validation sites, and ensuring a robust and efficient industrialization process.
This position is at the crossroads of electrical engineering, product validation, and industrialization, within a fast-growing and international environment.
 What You’ll Do
 Electrical Design & Product Definition
 - Define electrical architecture and specifications of PDU (Power Distribution Unit) products;
 - Specify wiring, connectors, terminals, breakers, and overall electrical integration;
 - Contribute to System Requirement Specifications (SRS);
 - Ensure consistency between mechanical and electrical design.
 Product Validation & Testing
 - Define, plan and execute product validation strategies (DVT);
 - Develop and perform electrical and thermal testing;
 - Analyze test results and ensure product compliance with specifications;
 - Identify risks early and propose corrective actions. 
 Test Strategy & Industrialization
 - Define and implement test strategies from prototype to serial production;
 - Design and specify test benches, tooling, and validation means;
 - Lead the transfer of testing activities from R&D to manufacturing;
 - Ensure products are designed for testability and industrial efficiency. 
 Cross-functional & International Collaboration
 - Work closely with: Mechanical engineering teams (local)/Production & industrial teams/International stakeholders (France, China, others);
 - Coordinate with suppliers (especially in Asia) for components and validation;
 - Contribute to a global development environment with distributed expertise.
 Qualifications
 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: Electrical Engineering/Electronic Engineering/Electromechanical Engineering (with strong electrical focus);
 - 3+ years of experience in: Industrial environment (manufacturing, validation, or industrialization)/Product testing or validation.
 Skills
 Technical Skills:
 - Strong knowledge in: Electrical and/or electronic systems/Product testing (electrical, thermal)
 - Experience in: Test bench / tooling definition and development/Product industrialization processes;
 - Ability to: Define test specifications and strategies/Understand systems end-to-end (not siloed expertise).
 - Basic understanding of firmware or embedded environments (nice to have).
 Soft Skills
 - Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset;
 - Ability to work across cultures and geographies;
 - Pragmatic, hands-on, and solution-oriented;
 - Ability to bridge R&D and industrial constraints;
 - Good listening skills and adaptability to field feedback.
 Languages
 - English (mandatory): ability to work in an international environment(Emails, technical documentation, supplier communication).
 What We’re Looking For
 - Autonomous engineer with a solid technical foundation;
 - Someone comfortable in a hands-on industrial environment (not purely R&D);
 - Ability to quickly ramp up and leverage global expertise;
 - Strong ownership mindset with a drive to build local capabilities.
 What We Offer
 - Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package;
 - Work in a fast-growing global company;
 - Challenging Projects in a dynamic, collaborative team;
 - Excellent Working Environment – safety and ethics are really important to us.

 Epiroc Maroc recrute un Coordinateur Logistique (H/F) rattaché(e) à l'organisation "Supply Chain du Groupe Epiroc"
 Dans le cadre du renforcement de nos activités Supply Chain, nous recherchons un Coordinateur Logistique pour apporter du support logistique à la société de vente sur tous les aspects de la Supply Chain, de soutenir l’équipe dans la gestion quotidienne des opérations logistiques et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la performance opérationnelle, tant sur le marché local, qu’en relation avec les ventes directes effectuées sur les pays de l’Afrique du Nord.
Le titulaire du poste aura également pour mission de garantir l’adhésion locale aux règles internationales de la conformité commerciale (Trade Compliance), de favoriser et d’optimiser l’utilisation des accords de libre-échange, et d’assurer un suivi efficace des flux de stock.
 MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
 - Suivre les flux entrants selon les modes de transport prédéfinies, en respectant les routines de livraison mises en place, dans le but de maximiser la consolidation des expéditions et d’optimiser les coûts de transport.
 - Assurer le contrôle quotidien des rapports de commandes ouvertes, en coordination avec les équipes des différents Centres de Distribution, afin de détecter les erreurs, d’anticiper les corrections nécessaires et de garantir un traitement fluide et régulier des expéditions automatisées et ponctuelles.
 - Accompagner le Supply Chain Manager dans la mise en œuvre locale des processus de la conformité commerciale (parties sanctionnées, Codes douaniers …), la conservation des documents et la formalisation des procédures, en alignement avec la politique Groupe.
 - Contribuer à l’application des bonnes pratiques Supply Chain en matière de gestion des stocks, avec pour objectif d’améliorer la disponibilité, de réduire les niveaux des stocks et d’optimiser les coûts de transport et de stockage.
 - Gérer les demandes spéciales de stockage (de remise à niveau, stocks planifiés, stocks critiques, lancement de équipements, consignation …), calculer les stocks recommandés sur la base des prévisions, des demandes, des pratiques de réapprovisionnement et de l’historique de consommation, en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales locales et avec les équipes de planification basées aux différents centres de distribution.
 - Veiller à la conformité des documents d’expédition liée aux exigences des Accord de libre-échange notamment l’accord Maroc–EU, en interaction avec l’équipe de Trade Compliance et avec les centres de distribution, notamment à travers l’accélération de la collecte des déclarations des fournisseurs (LTSD) et la mise à jour.
 - Collaborer étroitement avec les transitaires afin d’analyser, contrôler et optimiser les calculs de droits de douane et le positionnement tarifaire, sur la base des codes douaniers harmonisés, de la classification produit et de l’historiques des importations.
 - Participer à la revue, la mise à jour et le nettoyage de la base articles et des données logistiques dans notre ERP, ainsi qu’à la correction des erreurs de transmission EDI afin d’assurer un échange de données fiable et fluide.
 - Gérer les documents relatifs au dédouanement avec les différents intervenants.
 - Assurer la mise à jour régulière de notre application locale de gestion des importations afin de garantir la fiabilité des données.
 - Gérer le traitement des non-conformités constatées par l’équipe magasin, avec les différents centres de distribution et avec le département financier. 
 - Participer aux inventaires de stock ; traiter les retours de surplus aux centres de distribution, et traiter les démarches administratives y afférents avec les transporteurs et les transitaires.
 - Maintenir des contacts fréquents avec les centres de distribution, les usines de production et les différentes organisations Supply Chain, pour traitement proactif des différentes demandes des clients internes et externes (délais de livraison, litiges, cotations de transport, revue des documents …).
 - Participer à l’intégration et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants au poste / fonction
 - Respecter le règlement intérieur de l’entreprise
 Formation & Experience
 - Diplôme supérieur en Supply Chain Management, Logistique ou équivalent.
 - Une première expérience dans un poste similaire est requise.
 - Maîtrise de l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
 - Bonne compréhension des processus Supply Chain, du commerce international, de la réglementation douanière et des différents contrôles règlementaires de conformité à l’origine et aux frontières.
 - Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel ; la connaissance des ERP constitue un atout.
 - Une familiarité avec les outils d’intelligence artificielle serait appréciée
 COMPETENTECES ATTENDUES
 Nous recherchons une personne proactive, organisée et capable de s’adapter à un environnement Supply Chain dynamique et en constante évolution. Le candidat devra faire preuve d’un bon esprit de communication, d’une forte capacité d’apprentissage, d’une ouverture à l’innovation et d’une aptitude à collaborer efficacement avec différents interlocuteurs internes et externes.
 NOUS OFFRONS
 Une opportunité d’évoluer au sein d’une équipe collaborative, dans un environnement international et anglophone favorisant l’apprentissage rapide, le développement des compétences et l’exposition à des sujets variés liés à la Supply Chain, au Trade Compliance, à la gestion des stocks et à l’optimisation des coûts logistiques.
 DESCRIPTION DU PAYS ET DE LA VILLE:

 We are seeking an iGaming Quality Engineer to join our team on a contractual basis. The role is fully remote, with occasional travel required to our headquarters in Málaga, Spain. Candidates must operate through a fully registered limited company.
 THE ROLE 
 We build slot games played by millions — and we need someone who can break them before our players do.
 As a i Gaming Quality Engineer , you'll be embedded directly in game development squads, owning quality across the full lifecycle of Game Development: from early playability reviews and math verification to cross-browser regression suites and live certification sign-off.
 You'll work at the intersection of game design, frontend engineering, and regulatory compliance — ensuring every spin, every win animation, every bonus trigger is pixel-perfect, mathematically sound with the correct payment accuracy, and jurisdiction-ready.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 - Design and execute test strategies for slot games and other casino product lines, covering core mechanic loops, free spins, cascades, bonus buys, and progressive jackpots.
 - Verify frontend RNG output against certified math models, validating pay tables, RTP values, hit frequencies, and volatility bands.
 - Build and maintain automated regression suites using Playwright or Cypress targeting critical game-state flows, ensuring rapid feedback on every build.
 - Conduct cross-device and cross-browser testing (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, mobile iOS/Android), documenting rendering defects and frame-rate regressions.
 - Collaborate with artists and animators to validate Spine/PixiJS animations, transition states, and audio sync across game events.
 - Support regulatory certification testing for MGA and other jurisdictions — preparing evidence packs and liaising with labs.
 - Integrate quality gates into CI/CD pipelines; define pass/fail criteria for automated smoke, sanity, and performance checks on every merge.
 - Participate in design reviews and sprint planning, raising testability concerns early and contributing to definition-of-done standards across squads.
 REQUIRED SKILLS 
 - Industry Experience : Previous experience in iGaming is required for this role
 - Core QE : Test planning · Bug lifecycle · Regression suites · Root cause analysis · Risk-based testing
 - Frontend: JavaScript / TypeScript · PixiJS · Chrome DevTools · Browser profiling
 - Automation: Playwright · Selenium · Cypress · CI/CD (GitHub Actions) · API mocking
 - iGaming Domain: Slot math basics · RTP / RNG concepts · Bonus mechanics
 - Practices: BDD, TDD, API testing
 NICE TO HAVE 
 - Scripting bonus simulations or RTP verification tools in Python or Node.js.
 - Knowledge of responsible gambling UX requirements and in-game safeguard features.
 - Previous work in a regulated gambling, fintech, or payments QE environment
 WHO YOU ARE 
 - A player at heart — you think about quality from the player's perspective first, not just the ticket tracker.
 - Methodical and detail-obsessed: a misaligned win frame or a one-frame audio stutter bothers you the same way a logic bug does.
 - Collaborative by nature — you thrive working closely with developers, artists, producers, and compliance teams without silos.
 - Comfortable with ambiguity in early-stage game development, able to adapt test plans as designs evolve mid-sprint.
 - A clear communicator who writes sharp bug reports and gives focused, constructive feedback in design reviews.

 Gonini (formerly Bezos.AI) a fourni la fourchette de salaires
 Cette fourchette est fournie par Gonini (formerly Bezos.AI). Votre rémunération réelle sera basée sur vos compétences et votre expérience. Parlez-en à votre recruteur pour en savoir plus.
 Fourchette de salaires de base
 50 000,00 £GB/an - 80 000,00 £GB/an
 About Us
 Bezos.ai is a Fulfilment-as-a-Service (FaaS) platform. Online sellers connect their sales channels (Amazon, eBay, Shopify) and we orchestrate the rest, routing orders to a global network of warehouse and carrier partners, tracking every parcel to the customer's door, and giving sellers one clean view of their entire supply chain. We are a small, fast-moving, AI-native team scaling almost doubling our business in 2026. Operations is the engine room: when it runs well, sellers grow and the platform compounds.
 Your Mission
 Own a meaningful slice of operations end-to-end — and build the tools, automations and playbooks that let our network scale without adding headcount. You'll own the daily heartbeat of the platform: making sure tickets are resolved within SLA, reconciling data across systems, hunting down the orders that fall through the cracks, holding warehouses and carriers to their SLAs, and turning recurring operational pain into permanent fixes (often as a Claude skill or agent, a Retool dashboard, or a Make automation you build yourself).
 Core Pillars
 - Keep the flow clean: Reconcile the Bezos Platform, WMS and Operations Dashboard daily; find and resolve missing/stuck/mismatched orders before sellers notice
 - Hold the network to account: Monitor warehouse & carrier performance against SLAs; chase, escalate and reconcile invoices against rate cards
 - Build the machine: Replace manual, repetitive work with Claude skills/agents, automations and dashboards, so the team scales output, not headcount
 - Close the loop on sellers: Resolve operational tickets fast, find the root cause, and fix it upstream so it doesn't recur
 What You'll Achieve In Your First 90 Days
 - Own the daily cross-system reconciliation and cut the count of unresolved order exceptions to near zero
 - Ship at least one automation, Claude skill or agent that removes a recurring manual task from the team's week
 - Take ownership of a slice of the warehouse/carrier portfolio: running its performance reviews and invoice reconciliation independently
 - Move at least one company OKR (despatch rate, contact rate, or resolution time) in the right direction and present it in the weekly metrics review
 Requirements
 What we're looking for (non-negotiables)
 - AI-native: beyond the chat box. You've used Claude (or equivalent) to build things that run on their own: skills, agents, or automated workflows. Not just back-and-forth chat. You can show us what you built, what it does unattended, and where you keep a human in the loop. This is a hard requirement, and we will ask you to demonstrate it
 - Autonomous operator: You figure things out on your own and own complex problems end-to-end with only light guidance. (you're consistently ahead of the ask and can own a Key Result.)
 - Numerate & analytical: A degree (or clearly demonstrated equivalent ability) in a quantitative discipline such as engineering, maths, physics, CS, or a heavily numerate economics / finance / quant-social-science track. It's the analytical horsepower we're screening for, not the department name
 - A track record of measurable impact: You can point to specific, quantified outcomes you drove, eg cost down, a KPI moved, a process that got faster, not just responsibilities you held
 - A builder. You don't just spot the broken process, you fix it for good, by building the tool, commissioning the build, or redesigning the process. Evidence of systems, automations, dashboards or playbooks others now rely on
 - Energised by startups: You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, own outcomes end-to-end, and want a wide remit over a narrow one
 - Clear communicator: Writes crisply, presents findings simply, and tells people what to do next, not just what's wrong
 Nice-to-haves
 - E-commerce, logistics, 3PL or supply-chain exposure
 - Light coding (Python / SQL / JavaScript) or no-code tooling (Make, Zapier, Retool, Airtable)
 - Experience working with external partners or vendors against SLAs
 - Experience mentoring, training or managing 1-2 people
 Benefits
 - Work in a genuinely AI-native team. Build with Claude, Retool and Make daily, with real budget and the freedom to automate your own job
 - The ability to shape your role in a fast-growing, exciting company at the forefront of the future of e-commerce
 - A workplace that's entrepreneurial, fast-paced, outcome-focused and disciplined, but also highly collaborative, team-oriented and fun
 - Significant opportunity for growth and personal development, and the chance to have a real impact
 - The team is fully remote, but meets in person a couple of times a month
 - 25 holidays + 8 bank holidays
 - Mental health support through Spill, and a free Headspace subscription

 Remote location(s): Czechia. Minimum qualifications:
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
 - 8 years of experience in mechanical sustaining engineering.
 - Experience in working with suppliers via product life cycle (PLC) engagement models (e.g., agreement manufacturer, joint design manufacturing model (JDM), and original device manufacturer (ODM)).
 - Experience with manufacturing processes such as sheet metal fabrication, injection molding.

 Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience setting up manufacturing assembly processes, driving product launches and assembly process optimization within manufacturing operations.
 - Experience collaborating with contract manufacturers and suppliers to resolve manufacturing issues and drive process improvements.

 About The Job
 Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.
The Manufacturing Operations team is responsible for providing the manufacturing capability to deliver this physical infrastructure. As a Manufacturing Mechanical Engineer, you will support the product manufacturing with our contract manufacturer partners and create the processes, tools and procedures to ensure specifications and deliveries are met. You will be ensuring manufacturing processes are repeatable and controlled. You will collaborate with Commodity Managers, Supplier Quality Engineers and Design Engineers to determine Google’s infrastructure needs and product specifications. Your work will ensure the various pieces of Google’s infrastructure fit together perfectly and keep our systems humming along smoothly for a seamless user experience.
The Global Manufacturing Operations organization works closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, and Commodity Management teams as well as our Manufacturing Partners to produce Google Cloud infrastructure for Google's fleet of data centers. You will be responsible for leading the development, qualification, and continuous improvement of mechanical parts and the integration of all them at partner sites globally.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Czech Republic: Kč1580000 - Kč1620000 (CZK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
 Responsibilities

 - Review and influence designs using design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) fundamentals to develop manufacturable and scalable products. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Mechanical Engineering, Supply Quality Engineering, Program Managers and Global Commodity Manager.
 - Lead product qualifications from mechanical parts and assemblies to L11 rack integration at agreement manufacturing partners. Drive the coot cause correction action (RCCA) investigations to resolve manufacturing and system assembly issues.
 - Audit suppliers, and influence sourcing strategy by providing technical feedback to the commodity management team. Lead mechanical part suppliers to improve the manufacturing yield, efficiency and throughput.
 - Analyze product system assembly needs, influence mechanical designs changes, and identify solutions to problems.
 - Lead manufacturing process design, optimization, and qualification. Be responsible for the mechanical parts qualification and factory physical capacity increase to build up a supply chain resilience.

 Canada - Remote
 Process Engineer
 Full-Time, Permanent (Hybrid) 
 Canada (AB, MB, SK, QC, NB, NS) 
 Graymont is seeking a Process Engineer to play a key role in supporting our lime and limestone and manufacturing operations. This position will focus on process optimization, safety and innovation while contributing the development and implementation of advanced technologies within our Low Carbon Cementitious Solutions (LCCS) initiatives. Reporting to the Process Engineering Manager, the successful candidate will drive continuous improvement efforts, support project execution, enhance product quality and environmental compliance, and ensure alignment with industry best practices across all Graymont operations.
 Responsibilities
 Safety & Leadership
 - Champion safety as a core value across all operations.
 - Lead and/or participate in cross-functional teams to improve safety, quality, and operational efficiency.
 - Facilitate cultural and technical change aligned with continuous improvement and other strategic initiatives.
 Process Optimization & Technical Support
 - Troubleshoot and resolve process issues in lime, limestone, and LCCS manufacturing, handling and shipping processes.
 - Support equipment selection, layout design, and commissioning activities.
 - Conduct heat and mass balances using tools such as pitot tubes, gas analyzers, and magnehelic gauges.
 - Develop and monitor various operations KPIs and conduct process audits.
 - Collaborate with plant personnel, remote operations, contractors, and technical teams to implement innovative solutions.
 Environmental & Regulatory Compliance
 - Work with cross-functional teams (local & remote), including HSE to ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulations.
 - Understand combustion practices and emissions limits and other regulatory requirements.
 Project & Innovation Support 
 - Develop scopes of work and assist in permitting activities.
 - Record and share process updates and best practices.
 - Stay informed of technological advancements in lime, cement, and related industries.
 Qualifications
 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Controls Engineering and or a related field.
 - Professional Experience: Minimum of 4 years in lime, cement, industrial minerals, or other heavy industrial sectors.
 - Technical Requirements:
 - Strong understanding of pyro-processing, process control systems, and instrumentation.
 - Proficient in performing heat and mass balance calculations to support process optimization and performance analysis.
 - Well-versed in MS Suite, including Excel and Word.
 - Relevant Experience: Project management and plant commissioning experience.
 - Travel Requirements: Willingness to travel regularly throughout the U.S. and Canada (up to 50%).
 - Language Skills: English fluency required; proficiency in French or Spanish considered an asset.
 Who You Are
 - Effective Communicator: You are an active listener who can communicate effectively with different audiences in diverse situations.
 - Self-Starter and Collaborative Team Member: You are able to work effectively as an individual contributor and within a high-performance team environment.
 - Effective Time-Management: You effectively prioritize tasks and manage your time to ensure deadlines are met.
 - Problem Solving: You love immersing yourself in difficult technical problems and coming up with solutions that work. You think outside the box and use your experience and intuition to identify when such solutions are realistic.
 - Drive for Results: You set high standards and consistently work toward achieving goals, staying focused on delivering quality outcomes and exceeding expectations.
 Who We Are
 Founded in 1948, Graymont is a trusted global leader in essential calcium-based solutions. Professionally managed and family-owned, we proudly serve a wide range of markets, customers, and communities throughout North America and Asia Pacific. Graymont is also the strategic partner of Grupo Calidra, the largest lime producer in Latin America.
Graymont’s strategy is anchored in its strong commitment to its core values of integrity, respect, teamwork, innovation, excellence, accountability, and long-term perspective.
Central to our philosophy is a long-term approach to our business, built on a solid commitment to sustainable growth and focus on decarbonization, all of which is embodied in our mission statement: Contributing to a decarbonized world by providing essential lime and limestone solutions.

If you're interested in exploring our current job opportunities, please visit us at www.graymont.com/en/careers .

 Dangerous Goods

 - Monitor freight partner compliance with DG handling standards and raise issues to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead

 - Stay current on changes to regulations, dual-use regulations, and customs procedures relevant to [Company Name]’s trade lanes
 Site Coordination & Continuous Improvement

 - Work closely with production, supply chain, and engineering teams to align logistics priorities with operational needs
 Essential

 Preferred
 - Experience with temporary export regimes, ATA carnets, and trade event logistics

 Harmattan AI ships specialised hardware to customers, partners, and events across the world in a complex regulatory environment.  QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? 
 Hellomaterials est une marque internationale spécialisée dans les équipements outdoor premium. Opérant avec une équipe au Maroc.
 Nous recherchons un(e) Supply Chain & Quality Manager pour piloter l'ensemble de notre chaîne logistique internationale et notre contrôle qualité, avec un objectif clair : livrer rapidement, à coût optimisé, et avec une qualité produit irréprochable sur le marché américain.
 VOTRE RÔLE 
 Vous serez le/la propriétaire de notre supply chain de bout en bout. Votre mission est de transformer notre logistique actuelle (expéditions depuis l'étranger) en un dispositif international performant : fulfillment aux US, gestion des retours, contrôle qualité usine, packaging professionnel, et préparation au lancement Amazon FBA.
 Vos missions principales : 
 - Auditer la supply chain actuelle et identifier les leviers de réduction de coût et d'amélioration de service
 - Établir un 3PL aux États-Unis pour le fulfillment des commandes Shopify DTC, avec délais de livraison rapides
 - Préparer et piloter le lancement Amazon FBA : expéditions internationales vers les centres Amazon US, conformité packaging et étiquetage, prévisions d'inventaire
 - Établir un processus de contrôle qualité à la source (chez les fournisseurs à l'étranger) pour garantir la qualité avant expédition
 - Auditer notre catalogue produit et identifier les références à conserver, supprimer ou améliorer en fonction de leur qualité et performance
 - Développer le packaging produit : design professionnel, expérience d'unboxing premium, optimisation des coûts d'emballage
 - Construire un processus de retours efficace et fluide pour les clients américains
 - Collaborer avec le département Marketing pour aligner la roadmap produit avec la stratégie de marque
 - Collaborer avec le département Acquisition pour identifier des opportunités de promotion, bundles ou offres de rétention
 - Former le département Customer Service sur le suivi des commandes, les délais, les processus de retour et de réclamation
 - Explorer à moyen terme l'expansion logistique vers l'Europe
 - Gérer les relations fournisseurs : négociation, fiabilité, capacité, qualité
 - Produire des reportings réguliers sur les KPIs supply chain : délais, coûts, qualité, taux de retour, niveau de stock
 PROFIL RECHERCHÉ 
 Obligatoire : 
 - Formation supérieure Bac+3 minimum en supply chain, logistique, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent
 - Minimum 4 ans d'expérience en supply chain et qualité produit, idéalement avec une exposition au marché américain ou international
 - Expérience en e-commerce ou en biens de consommation (les profils issus uniquement du B2B industriel ne correspondent pas au poste)
 - Compréhension des opérations 3PL et des processus d'importation internationale
 - Familiarité avec les processus Amazon FBA : préparation, expédition, étiquetage, prévisions d'inventaire
 - Expérience en contrôle qualité fournisseurs, idéalement à l'étranger
 - Bilingue Français / Anglais, l'anglais est la langue de travail avec la direction et les partenaires internationaux
 - Forte orientation data : vous prenez vos décisions sur la base des chiffres, pas de l'intuition
 - Capacité à négocier avec des fournisseurs et prestataires internationaux
 - Disponibilité immédiate
 Fortement apprécié : 
 - Expérience directe avec des opérations aux États-Unis
 - Expérience dans le e-commerce D2C, Direct-to-Consumer
 - Expérience avec des marques outdoor, lifestyle, sport ou premium
 - Connaissance de Shopify et de son écosystème logistique
 - Expérience en design packaging et optimisation des coûts d'emballage
 - Maîtrise du chinois (atout pour la relation fournisseurs)
 CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS 
 - Un salaire net compétitif de 8 000 à 15 000 MAD selon expérience
 - La responsabilité complète de la supply chain et qualité d'une marque internationale en pleine croissance
 - Un rôle stratégique avec un impact direct sur la performance et la rentabilité de l'entreprise
 - Un environnement de travail exigeant, structuré et orienté résultats
 - Bureau moderne à Rabat, Agdal

 - Suivre les indicateurs de performance.

 The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) at Hyper Solutions is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of supplier-provided materials, components, and assemblies used in Hyper Solutions’ products. This role works closely with suppliers, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing teams to monitor supplier performance, resolve supplier-related quality issues, and ensure materials meet Hyper’s specifications and quality standards.
 This position plays a key role in building scalable supplier quality systems that support Hyper’s rapid growth and mission-critical infrastructure products. The Supplier Quality Engineer drives supplier development, leads corrective action initiatives, and supports supplier readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.
 Core Responsibilities 
 - Monitor supplier quality performance to ensure materials meet Hyper specifications and quality standards.
 - Lead supplier corrective action processes including SCAR management and structured root cause investigations.
 - Conduct supplier quality audits and evaluate supplier manufacturing processes and quality control plans.
 - Support supplier qualification, onboarding, and approval processes.
 - Partner with suppliers to improve process capability, defect prevention, and manufacturing quality.
 - Track supplier performance metrics and drive improvement initiatives across the supplier base.
 - Collaborate with procurement, engineering, and manufacturing teams to resolve supplier-related quality issues.
 Additional Responsibilities 
 - Support implementation of supplier inspection strategies based on supplier risk, maturity, and performance.
 - Coordinate with incoming inspection teams to ensure appropriate inspection plans and sampling methods are applied.
 - Support supplier readiness for new product introduction (NPI) programs and engineering changes.
 - Assist with First Article Inspection (FAI) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities when applicable.
 - Develop supplier scorecards, dashboards, and quality performance reporting.
 - Provide technical guidance to suppliers on inspection requirements, process controls, and quality standards.
 What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day 
 - Reviewing supplier defect reports and coordinating corrective actions with suppliers.
 - Communicating with suppliers to investigate and resolve quality issues.
 - Analyzing supplier performance data and identifying improvement opportunities.
 - Participating in supplier audits and manufacturing process evaluations.
 - Supporting supplier readiness for new product launches and engineering changes.
 - Collaborating with procurement and engineering teams to ensure supplier alignment.
 Requirements
 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field
 - Minimum of 3 years of experience working with supplier quality, manufacturing quality, and supplier development programs.
 - Experience conducting root cause investigations and implementing corrective actions
 - Experience collaborating cross-functionally with procurement, engineering, and manufacturing teams
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
 Preferred 
 - Experience working with mission-critical electrical infrastructure or power distribution equipment.
 - Familiarity with electrical components such as circuit breakers, bus bars, transformers, PCBs, and power distribution assemblies.
 - Experience supporting supplier qualification programs including FAI or PPAP.
 - Knowledge of quality standards such as ISO 9001 or ISO 17025.
 - Familiarity with industry standards such as ASTM, IPC, or UL.
 Why Hyper? 
 Hyper Solutions is building next-generation infrastructure solutions that power rapidly expanding data center and high-performance computing environments. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with engineering, procurement, and manufacturing teams to ensure supplier performance and product reliability. You’ll play an important role in strengthening Hyper’s supplier network, improving manufacturing quality, and supporting the production of mission-critical infrastructure systems.
 Hyper offers competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k), along with opportunities for career growth as the company continues to scale.

This hire will be eligible for a discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

 Supply Chain Manager – Samako Cleaning 
 Rewarding Salary + Benefits 
 Full Time
 Remote | EU-Based
 We’ve partnered with Samako Cleaning, a fast-scaling DTC brand in the home care space, now looking to hire an experienced Supply Chain Manager to own and optimise its end-to-end supply chain.
 About Samako Cleaning 
 At Samako, we believe a clean home creates a clear mind.
 Cleaning shouldn’t feel like a chore or a source of frustration; it should bring calm, clarity and balance to everyday life.
 Samako designs minimalist, beautifully crafted cleaning companions that are made to be seen and used. Rooted in Dutch design, its products combine form and function to create effortless routines and peaceful spaces.
 In just five years, Samako has grown into a much-loved brand with more than 100,000 happy customers, strong sales across Bol.com, Amazon and its own webshop, and a highly engaged community.
 Following this strong and consistent growth, Samako is entering its next phase of international expansion. To support its ambition of becoming a €100M+ brand, the business is now looking to build a resilient, scalable and data-driven supply chain operation.
 Check them out here: https://samakocleaning.com
 The Role 
 The Supply Chain Manager will take full ownership of Samako’s end-to-end supply chain, spanning demand forecasting, procurement, inventory planning, logistics and supplier management.
 This is much more than a support role.
 You’ll be responsible for ensuring products are available at the right time, in the right place and at the right cost. You’ll proactively identify risks and bottlenecks, improve systems and build strong relationships with manufacturers, suppliers, freight forwarders and warehouse partners.
 This is a hands-on build + scale opportunity for someone who wants genuine ownership and the opportunity to create a world-class supply chain operation.
 Responsibilities 
 - Own demand forecasting, inventory planning, purchasing and replenishment across all sales channels
 - Build rolling 3-, 6- and 12-month forecasts using sales history, seasonality, marketing activity, product launches and commercial targets
 - Maintain healthy stock levels across Bol.com, Amazon, Shopify and wholesale channels
 - Plan replenishments and manage purchasing cycles to ensure timely procurement and delivery
 - Lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning process, aligning demand, purchasing, inventory, marketing and finance
 - Manage relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, freight forwarders, 3PLs and warehouse partners
 - Build a resilient supplier and logistics network through contingency planning and backup partners
 - Optimise production, inventory and logistics to improve availability while controlling costs
 - Support international expansion, additional 3PLs, new sales channels and growing B2B operations
 - Ensure compliance with European import/export regulations, customs requirements and HS codes
 - Track supply chain KPIs and take corrective action when risks, delays or inefficiencies arise
 - Build scalable, data-driven systems and automate processes wherever possible
 - Document processes and continuously improve workflows as the business grows
 Day to Day 
 - Reviewing forecasts, inventory levels and replenishment requirements across every channel
 - Coordinating purchase orders and deliveries with international suppliers and logistics partners
 - Identifying potential stockouts, overstocks, delays and cost inefficiencies before they become problems
 - Aligning purchasing and inventory plans with marketing campaigns and product launches
 - Leading the monthly S&OP process across operations, marketing and finance
 - Monitoring supply chain performance and reporting actionable insights to the COO and CEO
 - Improving systems, processes and contingency plans to support continued international growth
 Requirements 
 - 5+ years of experience across supply chain management, logistics or procurement
 - At least 3 years of experience within DTC eCommerce
 - Strong demand forecasting, inventory planning and analytical capabilities
 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with inventory planning tools is advantageous
 - Experience managing international suppliers, manufacturers, freight forwarders and warehouse partners
 - Strong knowledge of international logistics, customs procedures and import/export regulations
 - Familiarity with Amazon FBA and Shopify fulfilment processes
 - Proven ability to design and implement scalable supply chain systems
 - Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills
 - Excellent communication skills in English
 - Comfortable working independently and taking full ownership of outcomes
 What Really Matters 
 More than anything, they’re looking for someone who:
 - Thinks proactively and identifies issues before they affect the business
 - Combines strong analytical skills with practical execution
 - Can bring structure and scalability to a fast-growing operation
 - Takes genuine ownership and accountability
 - Builds strong, commercially valuable supplier relationships
 - Remains calm and solutions-focused when navigating complex challenges
 - Wants to build an end-to-end supply chain capable of supporting a €100M+ brand
 Results 
 Success in this role will be measured by:
 - Accurate forecasts and on-time replenishment across all channels
 - Consistently high product availability with fewer stockouts and overstocks
 - Improved logistics and inventory efficiency without compromising service
 - Strong supplier relationships and favourable commercial terms
 - A reliable and scalable S&OP process
 - Full compliance with import/export laws and regulations
 - Clear, actionable reporting for the COO and CEO
 - A resilient supply chain that supports international growth without adding unnecessary operational complexity
 Why Join Samako? 
 - Join a brand with genuine momentum and more than 100,000 customers
 - Own the entire supply chain rather than one individual function
 - Play a central role in scaling the business towards €100M+
 - Build systems and processes with long-term international impact
 - Work directly with the leadership team
 - Enjoy real autonomy, accountability and progression
 - Join a compact team of ambitious, high-performing colleagues
 Benefits 
 - Excellent salary
 - Flexible, remote-first working
 - Unlimited vacation days, provided your responsibilities are covered
 - High-growth environment with genuine progression opportunities
 - Full ownership and autonomy to build and improve the supply chain
 - The opportunity to create a world-class operation supporting international growth
 If this sounds like you, hit apply or email Kyle at kyle@hypergrowthrec.co.uk to find out more!
 Samako is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are dedicated to supporting every team member’s success. Please let us know if you require any adjustments during the recruitment process.

 Hyprwork a fourni la fourchette de salaires
 Cette fourchette est fournie par Hyprwork. Votre rémunération réelle sera basée sur vos compétences et votre expérience. Parlez-en à votre recruteur pour en savoir plus.
 Fourchette de salaires de base
 60 000,00 $US/an - 95 000,00 $US/an
 About Us
 Hyprwork is a fast-growing operator that builds and scales direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, proved the model, with products like RejuvaKnee that help adults reclaim mobility and live with less pain, trusted by over 400,000 customers and shipping primarily to the United States. We have scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries, and our focus now is building and scaling the next generation of brands in the portfolio. We are remote-first, async-first, and we hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.
 The Role
 Hyprwork's entire physical business runs through OEM manufacturing in China and cross-border fulfillment into the United States: roughly 100,000 units per month, around 20 SKUs, three categories, and growing fast as we launch new brands. We are hiring a Head of Supply Chain to own that function end to end.
Here is the core of the job. You will build and lead our China execution team, from a distance. That means hiring and shaping the on-the-ground people in China (sourcing, QC, factory coordination), directing them from a timezone that overlaps with both their working hours and our US leadership, and setting the standard that makes the whole thing perform. You are the head of the function, and the China team is yours to build. At the same time, you are hands-on enough to deal with suppliers and factories directly when it matters, you are comfortable in a negotiation or a quality conversation yourself, not only through your team.
This is a director-level, function-ownership role. You design the supply chain, own its cost architecture, build the demand planning discipline, run dual sourcing as policy, and close the quality loop with factories. You report to the Director of Operations and partner with the founders on launches.
 What You Will Own
 Supply chain strategy and network design. Owning the end-to-end architecture from factory floor to customer door: supplier network, warehouse and 3PL footprint in southern China, carrier mix, and the roadmap that scales all of it for a multi-brand portfolio. Defining what the chain needs to look like two quarters from now and building toward it.
 Demand planning and S&OP. Building a real planning discipline: demand forecasts tied to sales velocity, campaign calendars, and launch schedules, with inventory targets of six to eight weeks of coverage held deliberately rather than accidentally. Balancing stockout risk against cash tied up in inventory, and making that trade-off visible to leadership.
 Sourcing and supplier strategy. Owning the OEM supplier portfolio: qualification, commercial negotiation across pricing, MOQ, payment terms and lead times, dual sourcing on high-velocity products as standing policy, and the supplier scorecard that keeps performance honest. Holding the two to three week request-to-warehouse-ready sourcing standard as the portfolio grows, and directing the China-based sourcing function rather than doing every negotiation personally.
 Logistics and cost architecture. Owning per-unit landed cost as a managed number. Current per-shipment costs run six to eight dollars and the mandate is to drive them toward industry benchmarks through competitive bidding, volume-based negotiation, and routing discipline across two or more shipping partners. Managing cross-border logistics for both DTC and the Amazon FBM channel.
 Quality and returns. Owning the returns and defect management loop with Customer Support: tracking quality patterns, taking them back to factories with data, and preventing recurrence structurally. Quality is a system you design, not a stream of incidents you absorb.
 Building and leading the China execution team, remotely. Hiring, structuring, and directing our on-the-ground people in China (sourcing, QC, factory coordination) from your timezone. Setting cadence, standards, and accountability so factory issues get caught and resolved without you being physically present. Building the team out as the portfolio grows, and being hands-on with suppliers and factories directly when the situation calls for it. Traveling to China periodically for audits, key negotiations, and relationship building.
 Requirements
 What We Are Looking For
 Proven experience building and directing a China-based execution team remotely , while based elsewhere. This is the core requirement. We are not looking for someone based in China, and we are not looking for someone who runs suppliers alone through third-party agents. We are looking for someone who has hired and led people on the ground in China from a distance, and made them perform, while staying close enough to the work to negotiate with suppliers and handle factory issues directly when needed. Willingness to travel to China periodically is expected.
Hands-on fluency with China suppliers and factories: you can run a price or MOQ negotiation, qualify a factory, and resolve a quality issue yourself, not only supervise someone who does. You know the commercial mechanics (payment terms, lead times, freight forwarding economics, volumetric weight pricing, single-source risk) firsthand.
A track record of building and developing teams. You have hired, coached, and raised the standard of the people under you, and you can describe how you turned executors into owners. The L3A standard at Hyprwork is developing other leaders and owning team outcomes, not just delivering personally.
A location that allows meaningful daily overlap with both Chinese working hours and an 8am to 12pm EST collaboration window. Eastern Europe, Turkey, and the Middle East are natural fits for this bridge, though we are open to any location that makes the timezone math work.
Fluency in the commercial mechanics of China manufacturing: factory qualification, MOQ and payment term negotiation, freight forwarding economics, volumetric weight pricing, and the failure modes of single-source dependency.
Strong English communication, written and spoken, under operational pressure and in leadership settings. This role reports upward to leadership, negotiates outward with partners, and coordinates across a globally distributed team, and clarity is non-negotiable in all three directions.
Comfort operating remote-first and async-first, with documented decisions, proactive escalation, and outcomes-based accountability. You do not wait for perfect tools: you can hold ERP-grade discipline on Google Sheets while you build what comes next.
 Benefits
 What We Offer
 A fully remote position with real ownership over a function the entire business depends on. Competitive compensation, paid time off, a wellness stipend, a company-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a monthly bonus structure, a birthday gift card, an in-country meetup allowance, and a leadership offsite. Direct exposure to founders and the mandate to build the supply chain organization for a multi-brand portfolio. The collaboration window for live work is 8am to 12pm EST; outside of that, we default to async.

 Country Study Operations Manager- Remote
ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.
We are currently seeking a Project Manager to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating project activities, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Your role will involve overseeing all aspects of project execution, from planning and resource management to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.
 What You Will Be Doing
 - Responsible for management/oversight of study and regional/country level activities from study startup through conduct and study close
 - May manage the study start up process in countries assigned (where SUPM not assigned) and/or oversee pCRO responsible for these activities as applicable
 - Through the Site Care Partner/Country Trial Manager or pCRO supports the Country/investigator outreach process, site identification and feasibility ensuring countries/sites can meet all study protocol requirements
 - Provides country level input on Startup and Recruitment milestones as provided by pCRO and/or Country Trial Manager/Site Care Partner to Global Study Manager during planning
 - Is accountable for overseeing pCRO and/or Country Trial Manager/Site Care Partner for assigned studies at country level in accordance with the overall project plan, manages and maintains accurate country level plans (e.g. timelines, budget, risk and quality plans)
 - Collaborates with accountable roles to identify and manage deviations and risks in study startup and execution and implements mitigation strategies as required. Is also accountable for resolution of Site Activation escalations to Study Teams including offering options for mitigation
 - Leader of the Local Study Team (core members: (Lead) Site Care Partners Clinical Trial Assistant, ad hoc members: ICL, Site Activation Partner, CTRO and Local Regulatory, Medical Affairs colleagues and other key stakeholders as required)
 - Ensures compliance to relevant Global and Local, internal and external requirements and regulations
 - Ensures timely communication bidirectionally between the global and local study team.
 - Provides protocol level guidance and support to responsible Local Study Team members as applicable.
 - Liaise with Site Care Partner, Lead Site Care Partner, Site Activation Partners and Regulatory colleagues in country to agree on submission strategy to Health Authorities and Ethic Committees
 - Utilize roles in countries such as Lead Site Care Partner, and expert roles such as Contracts Leads, Site Activation Partners to provide the Global Teams with local intelligence and operational nuances to be considered
 - Acts as the study level point of contact for all study-level questions for the Local Study Team, ensuring resolution at lowest possible level, and when needed liaising with and escalating to appropriate global roles/teams
 - Follows up on region/country level issue status to ensure resolution.
 - Identifies country level trends to improve deliverables processes as needed
 - Utilizes country intelligence to provide input on country specific risks into preparation of Investigational Quality Management Plan, Study Monitoring Plans, ensures PTMF completeness and oversight of all relevant compliance activities for allocated studies
 - Ensures audit/Inspection readiness during start-up and conduct
 - Manages applicable Quality Events with pCRO and local team as applicable and required
 - Coordinates effective site recruitment planning to allow for implementation of plans at the country and site level, consistent with global plan and local targets
 - Responsible to drive and ensure delivery of data cleaning deliverables for pCRO and sites as applicable
 - Provides input on Country level Per Subject Costs, local vendor costs and other fees where applicable
 - May act as a Subject Matter Expert
 - May lead operational effectiveness initiatives at country or regional level
 - Responsible for PTA and SIV report review for reports completed by the Site Care Partner
 - Supports implementation of client’s Site Technology Experience systems (e.g. Shared Investigator Platform SIP, Centralized Account Management CAM)
 - Support to EC/RA and other relevant (e.g. radiation, biobank) submissions and deficiency/query responses for initial and subsequent CTA submissions within required timelines
 - Drives pCRO and/or applicable internal study team members to ensure PTMF set up meets study requirements, and maintains oversight of PTMF completeness
 - Provides country level documents to PTMF and maintains oversight of Investigator Site File (ISF) reconciliation and completeness actions
 - Ensure pCRO and/or applicable internal study team members maintain appropriate level IP/equipment/ancillary supplies management including Import/Export License management with the support of Clinical Trial Assistants and other roles as required
 - Supports implementation of new tools and technologies (e.g. eConsent, eISF, Remote Source Access, remote SDV/SDR, iConnect, implementation of protocol required decentralized trial options etc.)
 - Support Identification, contract development and management of local vendors or facilities as per protocol
 - Investigator Meeting support and management including doing presentations as appropriate
 - Management of local Investigator Meetings including doing presentations as appropriate
 What You Need To Have
 - A scientific or technical degree is preferred along with knowledge of clinical trial methodology
 - BS/BSc/MS/MSc degree required
 - BA/BS 5+ years of relevant experience operational clinical trial experience
 - MBA/MS/ 3+ years of relevant experience operational clinical trial experience
 - Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, clinical and regulatory operations and environment in countries under responsibility
 - Demonstrated clinical research experience and/or study management/startup project manager experience
 - Demonstrated experience in managing country level operational activities and/or vendors
 - Experience in Study and Quality management and working in a matrix management environment
 - Expertise in the use of study/site dashboard and reporting tools
 - Detail oriented & possesses technical expertise
 - Ability to manage moderately complex processes
 - Ability to operate in a matrix environment
 - Risk Identification & Mitigation
 - Strategic Planning, Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
 - Critical Path Analysis
 - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
 - Ability to adapt to changing technologies and processes
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates
 Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Chef(fe) de Projet pour rejoindre notre équipe diversifiée et dynamique. En tant que Chef(fe) de Projet chez ICON, vous serez responsable de la direction et de la coordination des activités liées aux projets, en veillant à ce qu’ils soient livrés dans les délais, dans le respect du budget et selon les normes de qualité les plus élevées. Votre rôle consistera à superviser tous les aspects de l’exécution du projet, de la planification et de la gestion des ressources à la communication avec les parties prenantes et à la gestion des risques.
 Vos Responsabilités
 - Responsable de la gestion/supervision des activités au niveau de l’étude ainsi qu’au niveau régional/pays, depuis le démarrage de l’étude jusqu’à sa conduite et sa clôture.
 - Peut gérer le processus de démarrage des études dans les pays assignés (lorsqu’aucun SUPM n’est désigné) et/ou superviser le pCRO responsable de ces activités, le cas échéant.
 - Par l’intermédiaire du Site Care Partner / Country Trial Manager ou du pCRO, soutient le processus de sensibilisation des pays/investigateurs, l’identification des sites et l’évaluation de faisabilité afin de garantir que les pays/sites peuvent répondre à toutes les exigences du protocole.
 - Fournit des contributions au niveau pays concernant les jalons de démarrage et de recrutement, tels que communiqués par le pCRO et/ou le Country Trial Manager / Site Care Partner au Global Study Manager lors de la planification.
 - Responsable de la supervision du pCRO et/ou du Country Trial Manager / Site Care Partner pour les études assignées au niveau pays, conformément au plan global du projet ; gère et maintient des plans précis au niveau pays (ex. : calendriers, budget, plans de risques et de qualité).
 - Collabore avec les rôles responsables pour identifier et gérer les écarts et risques lors du démarrage et de l’exécution des études et met en œuvre des stratégies d’atténuation si nécessaire. Responsable également de la résolution des escalades liées à l’activation des sites auprès des équipes d’étude, en proposant des options de mitigation.
 - Responsable de l’équipe locale d’étude (membres principaux : (Lead) Site Care Partner, Clinical Trial Assistant ; membres ad hoc : ICL, Site Activation Partner, CTRO, collègues des Affaires Réglementaires locales, Affaires Médicales et autres parties prenantes clés si nécessaire).
 - Garantit la conformité aux exigences et réglementations pertinentes, globales et locales, internes et externes.
 - Assure une communication bidirectionnelle et en temps opportun entre l’équipe globale et l’équipe locale d’étude.
 - Fournit des orientations et un soutien au niveau du protocole aux membres responsables de l’équipe locale d’étude, selon le cas.
 - Collabore avec le Site Care Partner, Lead Site Care Partner, Site Activation Partners et les collègues réglementaires du pays afin de convenir de la stratégie de soumission aux Autorités de Santé et aux Comités d’Éthique.
 - Utilise les rôles pays (ex. : Lead Site Care Partner) et les rôles experts (ex. : responsables contrats, Site Activation Partners) afin de fournir aux équipes globales des informations locales et des spécificités opérationnelles à prendre en compte.
 - Agit en tant que point de contact au niveau de l’étude pour toutes les questions de l’équipe locale d’étude, en assurant la résolution au niveau le plus approprié et, si nécessaire, en assurant l’escalade vers les équipes/global roles concernés.
 - Suit l’état des problématiques au niveau régional/pays afin de garantir leur résolution.
 - Identifie les tendances au niveau pays afin d’améliorer les processus de livrables si nécessaire.
 - Utilise les informations pays pour contribuer à l’identification des risques spécifiques pays dans le cadre de la préparation du Plan de Gestion de la Qualité Investigationnelle, des Plans de Monitoring d’Étude, assure l’exhaustivité du PTMF et la supervision des activités de conformité pertinentes pour les études allouées.
 - Assure la préparation aux audits/inspections pendant le démarrage et la conduite des études.
 - Gère les événements qualité applicables avec le pCRO et l’équipe locale, si nécessaire.
 - Coordonne une planification efficace du recrutement des sites afin de permettre la mise en œuvre des plans au niveau pays et site, en cohérence avec le plan global et les objectifs locaux.
 - Responsable du pilotage et de la livraison des activités de nettoyage des données pour le pCRO et les sites, le cas échéant.

 - Peut agir en tant qu’expert métier (Subject Matter Expert).
 - Peut diriger des initiatives d’efficacité opérationnelle au niveau pays ou régional.
 - Responsable de la revue des rapports PTA et SIV complétés par le Site Care Partner.
 - Soutient la mise en œuvre des systèmes technologiques du client pour les sites (ex. : Shared Investigator Platform (SIP), Centralized Account Management (CAM)).
 - Soutient les soumissions aux Comités d’Éthique/Autorités Réglementaires (EC/RA) et autres soumissions pertinentes (ex. : radiations, biobanques) ainsi que les réponses aux demandes d’informations/queries dans les délais requis pour les soumissions CTA initiales et ultérieures.
 - S’assure que le pCRO et/ou les membres internes de l’équipe d’étude mettent en place un PTMF conforme aux exigences de l’étude et en maintient la supervision.

 - Veille à ce que le pCRO et/ou les membres internes de l’équipe gèrent de manière appropriée les produits investigués (IP), équipements et fournitures annexes, y compris la gestion des licences d’import/export, avec le soutien des Clinical Trial Assistants et autres rôles si nécessaire.
 - Soutient la mise en œuvre de nouveaux outils et technologies (ex. : eConsent, eISF, accès distant aux données sources, SDV/SDR à distance, iConnect, options d’essais décentralisés requises par le protocole, etc.).
 - Soutient l’identification, le développement contractuel et la gestion des fournisseurs ou établissements locaux conformément au protocole.

 - Gère les réunions investigateurs locales, y compris la réalisation de présentations si nécessaire.

 - Diplôme scientifique ou technique souhaité, avec connaissance de la méthodologie des essais cliniques.

 - Bonne connaissance des Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP), des opérations cliniques et réglementaires et de l’environnement réglementaire dans les pays sous responsabilité.

 The Company
 Industrial Technology Group (ITG) is an operating platform of The Heico Companies, LLC, overseeing 11 independent manufacturing companies which produce a wide array of equipment and products serving multiple industries and end users. ITG’s independent business model fosters entrepreneurship and growth and allows professional development at all levels.
ITG harbors a philosophy of developing close customer engagement, providing prompt, responsive service to meet our customer's changing needs, while striving to be leaders within our respective industries. Equipment and products are marketed domestically through a direct sales force, manufacturer's representatives and an established network of independent dealers. Internationally, ITG sells in more than 60 countries through an independent distributor network, company sales representatives, licensees and agents. Our portfolio of companies is diverse and has a solid management base, product/market niches and efficient manufacturing capabilities.
 Position Summary
 The Manufacturing Engineer develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes in alignment with product specifications and quality standards. This remote-based role requires approximately 75% travel to support manufacturing sites, where the engineer works directly on the shop floor to analyze equipment layout, workflow, assembly methods, and workforce utilization to drive efficiency and reduce waste. As a high-visibility position with exposure across multiple levels of the organization, the Manufacturing Engineer plays a key role in supporting the growth strategy of the Industrial Technologies Group and its Business Units.
 - Analyzes and plans work force utilization, space requirements, workflow, and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
 - Develops, evaluates, and improves manufacturing methods, utilizing knowledge of product design, materials and parts, fabrication processes, tooling and production equipment capabilities, assembly methods, and quality control standards.
 - Collaborate with planning and design staff concerning product design and tooling to ensure efficient production methods.
 - Works with vendors to determine product specifications and arrange for purchase of equipment, materials, or parts, and evaluates products according to specifications and quality standards.
 - Estimates production times, staffing requirements, and related costs to provide information for management
 - Coordinate with management, engineering, and other staff regarding manufacturing capabilities, production schedules, and other considerations to facilitate production processes.
 - Conducts Value Stream Analysis, manufacturing process flow redesigns, time and motion studies as part of the planning process.
 - Applies statistical methods to estimate future manufacturing requirements and capture potential efficiencies.
 - Leads plant employees in conceptualizing, planning, implementing, and sustaining continuous improvements by utilizing Lean Manufacturing tools.
 Job Requirements
 - Bachelor of Science in Mechanical/Manufacturing engineering required.
 - 3-5+ years’ work experience in a manufacturing facility in an engineering role with proven track record of delivering results. Strong internship experience will be considered in place of.
 - Proven ability to see facility projects through to completion, on time and within budget.
 - Able to effectively carry out a vision and collaborate with Production, Materials and Quality teams.
 - AutoCAD/Solid works experience required. Experience designing manufactured parts and developing comprehensive production floor layouts is preferred.
 - Technically proficient in applicable programs related to process improvement & MS Office.
 - Ability to present in a clear and concise manner within all layers of the organization.
 - Strong analytical, organization and communication skills.
 - A high energy team player with a go-getter attitude.
 - This role supports projects across multiple business units nationally, requiring 75% travel
 Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
 Work Environment 
 A Manufacturing Engineer works in a fast-paced production setting, balancing time on the shop floor with analytical planning. The role involves close collaboration with operators, maintenance, quality, and leadership to improve safety, efficiency, and performance. The environment can be loud, dirty, and subject to varying temperatures, requiring appropriate protective equipment and adaptability.
 Physical Demands
 This position requires frequent standing and walking on the production floor, with occasional bending, stooping, and reaching. The role may involve lifting and carrying materials or equipment up to 40 pounds and working around moving machinery. Employees must be able to tolerate varying temperatures, noise levels, and industrial conditions while wearing required personal protective equipment. Clear vision, including the ability to distinguish between colors, and strong attention to detail are essential.
 Compensation & Benefits
 Estimated salary range: $75,000 – $90,000 annually.
This position is eligible for the company’s full benefits package, including medical insurance, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, paid vacation and sick leave, and paid holidays.
 Key Competencies
 - Data Gathering and Analytics - Collecting, consolidating, and using relevant information; recognizing important information; tracing possible causes of problems, and searching for practical data/solutions.
 - Attention to Detail - Taking responsibility for a thorough and detailed method of working.
 - Planning and Organizing – Setting priorities and defining actions, time, and resources needed to achieve predefined goals.
 - Communication Skills - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively deliver and reinforce consistent messages at all levels. Excellent listening skills.
 - Problem Solving - Having the ability to identify problems and issues of varying complexities and to find effective solutions with few guidelines.
 - Teamwork - Working as a productive member of a cohesive group toward a common goal and contributing to team development and effective team dynamics.
 - Continuous Learning - Actively and continuously gaining insight of strengths and weaknesses to identify the relevant areas that need further development (with regard to skills and knowledge) and acting upon it.

 Required Skills & Experience
 • 7+ years of Change Management experience in large, enterprise environments
 • Experience within Supply Chain, Transportation, 3PL, Manufacturing, or Automotive environments
 • Proven experience supporting large-scale transformation initiatives (technology + process + people)
 • Strong background in stakeholder alignment and executive communication
 • Experience working cross-functionally (“horizontal” influence across business and IT)
 • Demonstrated ability to manage change at scale—planning, sequencing, and driving execution
 • Strong active listening and problem-solving skills; able to identify gaps and challenge assumptions
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (must be able to translate complex initiatives clearly)
 • Experience with data-driven change measurement (adoption metrics, engagement tracking, etc.)
 • Self-starter with ability to operate in ambiguity and build structure from scratch
 • High attention to detail with a project management mindset
 Nice to Have Skills & Experience
 • Background in consulting environments
 • Experience supporting TMS/WMS or supply chain system transformations (Blue Yonder a strong plus)
 • Experience building IT onboarding or enablement programs
 • Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Snagit, Kahoot!, and Microsoft Teams
 Job Description
 A 3PL Supply Chain, Transportation, and Logistics company is undergoing a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation. This initiative represents a fundamental shift across people, process, and technology, including the transition from a legacy, proprietary TMS to Blue Yonder TMS. This is not just a system implementation—it’s a large-scale operating model transformation. We're looking for a Change Enablement Consultant to drive adoption across the business, partnering closely with Change Leadership, Product, and Business stakeholders to ensure successful execution. This individual will play a critical role in identifying change impacts, managing resistance, and activating champions across the organization.
 Day to Day Responsibilities:
 • Partner with Change Leadership, Product, and Business stakeholders to execute end-to-end change strategies across the transformation program
 • Assess organizational impact, identify risks, and proactively manage resistance points across functions
 • Build and maintain strong stakeholder alignment across business and technology teams
 • Identify and engage change champions and influencers to drive adoption
 • Develop and execute communication and engagement strategies tailored to different audiences
 • Create executive-level presentations, talking points, and change materials for leadership and key stakeholders
 • Develop and maintain digital and visual communication assets (Teams, Canva, etc.)
 • Track and report on adoption metrics, engagement levels, and change effectiveness
 • Support development of IT onboarding and enablement programs for employees impacted by the transformation
 • Work cross-functionally to ensure consistent messaging, clarity, and information flow across the organization
