 About the Company 
 We're recruiting on behalf of a growing pharmaceutical organization committed to improving patient outcomes through the development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality healthcare products. As they continue to expand their operations across Europe and international markets, they are seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Supply Chain to lead and optimize our end-to-end supply chain function.
 Position Overview 
 The Head of Supply Chain will be responsible for developing and executing the company's supply chain strategy across procurement, demand planning, inventory management, manufacturing planning, warehousing, logistics, and distribution. The successful candidate will ensure an agile, compliant, and cost-effective supply chain that supports business growth while maintaining the highest standards of quality and regulatory compliance within the pharmaceutical sector.
 This role will partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Finance, and External Supply Partners to ensure seamless product availability and operational excellence.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Strategic Leadership 
 - Develop and implement the end-to-end supply chain strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
 - Lead the transformation and continuous improvement of supply chain processes, systems, and capabilities.
 - Drive supply chain resilience through effective risk management, scenario planning, and business continuity initiatives.
 - Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to improve service levels, operational efficiency, and cost performance.
 Supply Planning & Operations 
 - Oversee demand forecasting, supply planning, S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), and inventory optimization processes.
 - Ensure uninterrupted product supply across domestic and international markets.
 - Manage inventory levels to balance product availability, shelf-life considerations, and working capital requirements.
 - Collaborate with manufacturing and contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) to optimize production planning and capacity utilization.
 Procurement & Supplier Management 
 - Lead strategic sourcing activities and supplier relationship management.
 - Develop strong partnerships with suppliers, logistics providers, and contract manufacturing partners.
 - Negotiate contracts and service agreements to achieve cost efficiencies while maintaining supply security and compliance.
 - Evaluate supplier performance and implement continuous improvement programs.
 Logistics & Distribution 
 - Ensure efficient warehousing, transportation, import/export, and distribution operations.
 - Optimize logistics networks across Germany, Europe, and global markets.
 - Maintain compliance with GDP (Good Distribution Practice) requirements and applicable pharmaceutical regulations.
 - Monitor and improve OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance.
 Compliance & Quality 
 - Ensure full compliance with GMP, GDP, regulatory requirements, and company quality standards.
 - Support audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews related to supply chain activities.
 - Implement robust quality and risk management practices throughout the supply chain network.
 Leadership & Stakeholder Management 
 - Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing supply chain team.
 - Foster collaboration across cross-functional departments and external partners.
 - Provide regular operational and strategic updates to executive leadership.
 Required Qualifications 
 - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
 - 7+ years of progressive supply chain experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.
 - Proven leadership experience managing end-to-end supply chain operations and high-performing teams.
 - Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, including GMP, GDP, and quality management systems.
 - Demonstrated success in S&OP, inventory management, demand planning, procurement, and logistics.
 - Experience managing relationships with CMOs, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), and global suppliers.
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management capabilities.
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
 - Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 - Master's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or related field.
 - APICS/ASCM (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent professional certification.
 - Experience working within international or multi-site pharmaceutical environments.
 - Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP IBP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
 - Experience leading digital transformation and supply chain optimization initiatives.
 Key Competencies 
 - Strategic Thinking
 - Leadership & Team Development
 - Operational Excellence
 - Supply Chain Risk Management
 - Change Management
 - Data-Driven Decision Making
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Negotiation & Supplier Management
 - Process Improvement & Lean Methodologies
 What We Offer 
 - Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
 - Comprehensive benefits package.
 - Flexible working arrangements and hybrid working options.
 - Career development and leadership growth opportunities.
 - International exposure within a dynamic pharmaceutical environment.
 - Opportunity to play a critical role in delivering life-changing medicines to patients.

 Anne Vachez
 Rejoignez nos équipes en tant qu’Ingénieur Qualité Terrain 
 Passionné(e) par la technique et le diagnostic, vous souhaitez être au plus près de nos clients et de nos produits ? En tant qu’Ingénieur Qualité Terrain, vous intervenez sur les situations techniques les plus complexes pour accompagner le réseau, sécuriser les opérations et garantir la disponibilité des véhicules.
 Grâce à votre expertise, vous analysez les incidents critiques, pilotez les escalades techniques et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénierie, Qualité et Support Produit afin d’identifier les causes racines et déployer les actions correctives adaptées.
 Véritable ambassadeur de la Voix du Client, vous transformez les retours du terrain en leviers d’amélioration continue et contribuez activement à renforcer la qualité, la fiabilité de nos produits et l’expérience de nos clients.
 Principales responsabilités 
 1. Support et résolution des cas critiques 
 - Fournir des recommandations pratiques pour la gestion des incidents complexes, prioritaires ou non résolus, avec une forte orientation diagnostic.
 - Accompagner le déploiement des actions correctives sur le terrain en proposant et en validant rapidement des solutions de confinement technique.
 - Réaliser des diagnostics avancés sur des systèmes complexes en travaillant directement avec l’Ingénierie pour valider les hypothèses sur le terrain.
 2. Gestion des incidents terrain et collaboration transverse 
 - Garantir que les incidents complexes rencontrés sur le terrain soient documentés avec des données techniques complètes et de haute qualité, afin de permettre l’identification des causes racines à partir d’éléments tels que les journaux de diagnostic, vidéos, données « freeze-frame », données télématiques, kilométrage, cycles d’utilisation et conditions environnementales.
 - Escalader les problèmes critiques vers les équipes Ingénierie, Qualité Terrain et Support Produit en fournissant l’ensemble des preuves et données nécessaires.
 - Assurer l’exactitude de l’Issue Master au niveau mondial afin de garantir la visibilité et la cohérence des informations.
 3. Support aux concessionnaires, clients et flottes 
 - Effectuer des visites régulières auprès des flottes stratégiques et des clients confrontés à des problèmes récurrents ou critiques.
 - Rétablir la confiance des clients grâce à une communication claire, des actions techniques expertes et des délais d’intervention clairement définis.
 - Comprendre les conditions réelles d’utilisation (mission, terrain, charge, application) afin de soutenir une analyse technique précise.
 4. Représentation de la Voix du Client et du Réseau 
 - Recueillir les retours techniques des clients, gestionnaires de flotte, conducteurs et techniciens du réseau en tant qu’ambassadeur interne de la disponibilité des véhicules et de la satisfaction client.
 - Traduire les conditions réelles d’utilisation (charge, terrain, climat, type d’application, modes de conduite) en informations techniques exploitables.
 - Communiquer l’impact réel pour le client (immobilisation, remorquage, enjeux de sécurité, escalades sous garantie) directement aux équipes Qualité Produit, Analyse du Comportement Produit et/ou Qualité Fabrication, chargées de mettre en œuvre les actions appropriées.
 5. Lancements, formation et transfert de connaissances 
 - Participer aux dispositifs d’alerte précoce (Early Warning) lors du lancement de nouveaux produits sur le terrain auprès de flottes sélectionnées.
 - Fournir aux équipes Formation des retours techniques basés sur les problématiques émergentes observées sur le terrain.
 - Former et accompagner les techniciens des concessionnaires et des clients sur les procédures de diagnostic mises à jour ainsi que sur les meilleures pratiques.
 Profil recherché 
 - Formation supérieure technique (Bac+5 / Ingénieur) en mécanique, automobile, électronique ou domaine équivalent.
 - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement industriel ou automobile, idéalement dans les domaines de la qualité terrain, du support technique, de l'après-vente ou de l'ingénierie produit.
 - Expérience avérée dans le diagnostic de systèmes complexes et la résolution de problèmes techniques.
 - Expérience confirmée en qualité terrain, support technique, après-vente ou ingénierie produit.
 - Solides compétences en diagnostic et résolution de problèmes techniques complexes.
 - Forte orientation client et sens du service.
 - Connaissance de l'environnement des véhicules industriels obligatoire.
 - Excellentes compétences en communication et aptitude à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés (clients, concessionnaires, ingénierie, qualité, production).
 - Maîtrise des outils informatiques et de reporting technique (MS Office, outils de diagnostic, systèmes de gestion de qualité et de tickets).
 - Anglais professionnel courant.
 - Disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents (min. 50%).

 This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and operational excellence within a fast-growing technology environment.
You will partner with finance and cross-functional leaders to drive planning, forecasting, and high-impact business initiatives.
The position combines financial analysis, strategic problem-solving, and operational execution to support sustainable growth.
You will transform complex business questions into actionable insights that influence pricing, go-to-market strategies, and product investments.
The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous environments.
This is a high-visibility opportunity to work across teams including Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance while contributing to long-term company strategy.
 Accountabilities
 The Strategy & Operations Manager will serve as a strategic partner to business leaders by driving financial planning, operational improvements, and data-driven decision-making. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, ownership, and the ability to translate complex challenges into practical recommendations.
 - Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes across revenue, expenses, and cash flow.
 - Build, maintain, and improve financial models to support business planning and strategic decisions.
 - Conduct high-impact strategic analyses related to pricing, go-to-market performance, product launches, market opportunities, and business growth initiatives.
 - Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to identify opportunities, evaluate performance, and improve operational efficiency.
 - Support the operational foundation of embedded finance products by analyzing business models, partnerships, and growth opportunities.
 - Develop actionable recommendations by combining business insights, financial data, and market analysis.
 - Create and improve reporting frameworks, dashboards, and processes to increase visibility into business performance.
 - Use tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, and business intelligence platforms to gather, analyze, and communicate insights.
 - Drive automation and process improvements across financial planning and revenue operations.
 - Support corporate development initiatives, including market research, strategic opportunities, diligence activities, and investor reporting.
 - Prepare executive-level presentations and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
 Requirements
 The ideal candidate is a strategic and analytical professional with experience in finance, business operations, and high-growth technology environments. They should be comfortable working independently, managing ambiguity, and influencing decisions across multiple teams.
 - 5-7 years of professional experience, including 2-3 years within a high-growth SaaS or technology startup environment.
 - Previous experience in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations preferred.
 - Strong financial modeling skills with experience building and managing revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasts.
 - Advanced analytical skills with the ability to independently collect, manipulate, and interpret business data.
 - Experience using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Looker, Salesforce, Stripe, or similar business systems.
 - Ability to transform ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights, provide recommendations, and influence stakeholders.
 - Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams.

 This role offers the opportunity to support the deployment of innovative industrial technology solutions across manufacturing environments in the Americas.
You will combine industrial engineering expertise, automation knowledge, and project delivery skills to help customers optimize their operations.
The position involves working directly with plant teams, technical stakeholders, and engineering specialists to ensure successful software implementation.
You will contribute to technical validation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and operational improvement initiatives at customer sites.
The role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex industrial challenges and bridging business needs with technical solutions.
You will gain international exposure while supporting the adoption of advanced optimization technologies within large-scale industrial environments.
 Accountabilities
 As an Industrial Process Engineer, you will support the implementation and delivery of industrial software solutions by working closely with customer teams and internal engineering experts. You will ensure successful deployment, operational readiness, and continuous improvement throughout project lifecycles.
 - Execute implementation, commissioning, testing, and start-up activities at customer manufacturing facilities.
 - Validate industrial connectivity, communication systems, signals, and data availability required for software deployment.
 - Support configuration reviews, operational validation, and deployment of industrial optimization solutions.
 - Serve as the technical bridge between plant operations and internal Engineering, Data Science, and Project Delivery teams.
 - Gather operational requirements, identify technical challenges, and translate plant needs into actionable implementation plans.
 - Coordinate functional and technical testing with automation, maintenance, IT/OT, and engineering stakeholders.
 - Document project progress, configuration updates, technical issues, and implementation milestones.
 - Collect operational data, system logs, technical evidence, and customer feedback to support troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
 - Partner with Project Managers to coordinate activities, manage risks, and ensure successful project execution.
 - Support customer training, knowledge transfer, and adoption of implemented solutions.
 - Share lessons learned and contribute to improving implementation methodologies and engineering practices.
 Requirements
 The ideal candidate is an industrial engineering professional with experience in manufacturing environments, automation systems, and technical project delivery. You should be comfortable working directly with customers, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across different regions.
 - Degree or equivalent technical background in Industrial Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, or a related field.
 - 3+ years of experience delivering industrial technology, automation, commissioning, or implementation projects within manufacturing environments.
 - Hands-on experience working at industrial plant sites during implementation and commissioning phases.
 - Strong understanding of industrial automation, control systems, instrumentation, SCADA, historians, OPC, industrial communications, and IT/OT environments.
 - Experience collaborating with plant operators, maintenance teams, automation engineers, and customer stakeholders.

 Entreprise :
 KITEA Group acteur leader dans le secteur de l’ameublement et de la décoration au Maroc depuis plus de 30 ans, nous opérons sur l’ensemble du territoire marocain à travers le plus grand réseau de magasins en propre. Nos produits, conjuguant un design avant-gardiste, une durabilité affirmée et une compétitivité tarifaire, sont conçus pour combler toutes les préférences et nécessités. Au sein de KITEA, nous sommes à l’affût des évolutions, nous anticipons et nous nous adaptons constamment aux besoins de nos différents marchés. En associant nos marques emblématiques KITEA et KITEA KITCHEN à nos partenariats exclusifs internationaux ROCHE BOBOIS, ASHLEY HomeStore et CASA Shop, nos ambitions sont claires. À travers la solidité de nos marques, nous nous étendons au-delà de nos frontières et ambitionnons de devenir l’acteur de référence No 1 sur le continent africain.
 Nos récentes réalisations : 
 En novembre 2023, nous avons dévoilé notre nouveau magasin de dernière génération sur plus de 10 000 m² dans notre centre Viva Park à Casablanca, avec un investissement de plus de 270 millions de dirhams. En avril 2023, c’était au tour de KITEA Géant Agadir d’ouvrir ses portes dans notre centre commercial, s’étendant sur plus de 42 000 m² commerciaux. La nouvelle génération de KITEA Géant ? Rien de moins que les plus grands magasins d’ameublement au Maroc. Nous avons également étendu notre présence à l’international avec une implantation au Kenya en 2022 et au Ghana en 2023. Nous disposons aussi du plus grand centre logistique au Maroc pour accompagner notre croissance et, dans le même élan, notre siège a doublé de taille (de 1 000 m² à 2 000 m²).

Le bien-être au travail est au cœur de nos priorités et nous nous engageons à maintenir nos standards élevés. Nous valorisons vos compétences, votre expérience et votre état d’esprit. Notre objectif : attirer et fidéliser les meilleurs talents.

L’entreprise favorise un management de proximité, soutenant l’engagement, la responsabilisation et le développement des collaborateurs. Cette dynamique collaborative est enrichie par une ouverture à l’innovation , encourageant l’agilité, la créativité et l’adaptation aux évolutions du marché. Elle s’appuie également sur une organisation structurée et une culture de performance, garantissant efficacité, fiabilité et orientation résultats.

 Operations & Supply Chain Centre of Excellence (CoE) - Manager -109202

 Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time 
KPMG’s Strategy Group practice is looking for exceptional candidates for a manager role, with a background in Procurement. Ideally with some experience in Deals (Integrations, Separations and Due Diligence).
The Operations CoE team is part of KPMG’s rapidly expanding Strategy Group, which provides advice to deliver greater value for clients by bringing deep industry and functional insights in deals. We are a diverse team of over 150 practitioners, working collaboratively with and orchestrating KPMG’s broad set of capabilities within our Deal Advisory business. We provide assistance to clients navigating complex transactions.
 Why Join KPMG as an Ops & Supply Manager? 
 - Join KPMG's growing Operations & Supply Chain Centre of Excellence (CoE) within the Strategy Group, part of the Deal Advisory practice. 
 - Work with a diverse team of 150+ professionals supporting clients through complex transactions and business transformations. 
 - Gain exposure to high-profile M&A activities, including integrations, separations, carve-outs, and due diligence. 
 - Contribute to thought leadership, practice development, and innovative procurement solutions. 
 - Build a strong internal and external network while developing your leadership and consulting skills. 
 What Will You Be Doing? 
 - Lead and support procurement workstreams across buy-side and sell-side transactions throughout the deal lifecycle. 
 - Advise clients on procurement-related opportunities, risks, and organisational changes resulting from transactions. 
 - Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and act as a key day-to-day contact. 
 - Manage projects, coordinate deliverables, and provide strategic procurement insights and recommendations. 
 - Support business development activities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor junior team members. 
 - Ensure high-quality delivery while adhering to KPMG's risk and governance frameworks. 
 What Will You Need to Do It? 
 - 5–8 years' experience in Procurement within Consulting or Industry. 
 - Strong knowledge of procurement processes including sourcing, category management, strategic sourcing, contract management, SRM, and Source-to-Pay (S2P). 
 - Experience leading teams, managing projects, or delivering procurement transformation programmes. 
 - Understanding of procurement operating models, processes, systems, controls, and performance metrics. 
 - Exposure to M&A activities such as integrations, separations, carve-outs, or due diligence is desirable. 
 - Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work with senior stakeholders and provide practical, data-driven recommendations. 
 - Strong academic background; financial modelling experience and additional language skills are advantageous. 
 With 20 sites across the UK, we can potentially facilitate office work, working from home, flexible hours, and part-time options. If you have a need for flexibility, please register and discuss this with our team.

 Lead a High-Performing Manufacturing Operation 
 Kore Recruiters has been retained to conduct a confidential search for an experienced Plant Manager on behalf of an established and financially strong U.S. manufacturing organization.
 This is an opportunity for a proven operations leader to take full ownership of a manufacturing facility with responsibility for safety, production, engineering, maintenance, supply chain, quality, warehousing, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, developing high-performing teams, and executing strategic initiatives that support long-term business growth.
 Our client is seeking a leader who enjoys building engaged teams, solving operational challenges, improving manufacturing performance, and creating a culture focused on accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.
 The Opportunity 
 This position offers significant autonomy and visibility within the organization. As Plant Manager, you will oversee all aspects of plant operations while partnering closely with executive leadership to execute strategic initiatives that improve operational performance, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
 This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who is equally comfortable on the manufacturing floor as they are reviewing business metrics and leading strategic discussions.
 The ideal candidate is passionate about developing people, improving processes, and creating an environment where operational excellence becomes part of the culture—not just another initiative.
 What You'll Be Responsible For: 
 As Plant Manager, you will lead every aspect of daily manufacturing operations while driving long-term operational improvements across the facility. 
 Key areas of responsibility include: 
 - Overall leadership of manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, warehousing, shipping, quality, and supply chain operations.
 - Driving production performance while maintaining exceptional standards for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
 - Building and developing high-performing leadership teams through coaching, accountability, and employee engagement.
 - Leading Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives that improve productivity, efficiency, and profitability.

 What You Will Achieve
As a Supply Operations Quality Officer, you will play a critical role in ensuring that Pfizer products are managed, stored, distributed, and controlled in compliance with applicable GMP, GDP, Pfizer Quality Standards, and local regulatory requirements. You will help maintain a robust Quality Management System while protecting patients and customers from product quality risks.
In this role, you will:
 - Ensure compliance of Distribution Center operations with GMP/GDP requirements, Pfizer Quality Standards, and local Health Authority regulations. 
 - Manage and support quality systems including deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, training, commitment tracking, and inspection readiness. 
 - Lead investigations of product quality incidents, distribution complaints, temperature excursions, and other quality events. 
 - Support batch disposition activities, product returns management, quarantine alerts (QANs), and market actions when required. 
 - Provide quality oversight of third-party logistics providers, contractors, warehouses, and service providers. 
 - Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, and quality reviews, ensuring timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and improve local quality procedures, records, and compliance documentation. 
 - Monitor quality metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement across distribution and quality processes. 
 - Collaborate with Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial Operations, Global Quality, and external partners to ensure uninterrupted supply of quality products to patients. 
 - Promote a strong culture of quality, compliance, data integrity, and patient focus throughout the organization. 
 Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)
 - Doctor of Pharmacy degree (PharmD or equivalent Pharmacist qualification recognized in Morocco). 
 - Minimum 4 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry operating in a GMP and/or GDP regulated environment. 
 - Practical experience in pharmaceutical quality systems such as deviations, CAPAs, change controls, investigations, risk management, complaints management, or audits. 
 - Working knowledge of GMP, GDP, and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience working with quality documentation, SOPs, records management, and compliance programs. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex quality issues. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and effectively manage multiple priorities. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, French, and Arabic. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). 
 Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)
 - Experience as a Responsible Pharmacist, Qualified Person, or Quality Representative in pharmaceutical distribution, manufacturing, or supply chain operations. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections, customer audits, or corporate quality audits. 
 - Knowledge of temperature-controlled supply chains and cold-chain product management. 
 - Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), Veeva Vault, SAP, TrackWise, or similar systems. 
 - Experience overseeing third-party logistics providers (3PLs) and external service providers. 
 - Certification or formal training in Quality Risk Management, Root Cause Analysis, Lean, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement methodologies. 
 - Experience managing relabeling, repackaging, market actions, product recalls, or product disposition activities. 
 - Demonstrated leadership potential, project management experience, and ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions. 
 - Passion for quality, patient safety, and continuous improvement. 
 Work Location Assignment: On Premise

 OUR STORY
 At ST, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, business, and society. We are a global semiconductor company, and our advanced technology & chips forms the hidden part of the world we live in today.
When you join ST, you will be part of a global business of more than 115+ nationalities and present in 40 countries, 50,000+, diverse and dedicated creators & makers of technology around the world!
Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understands collaboration and respect. People with passion and desire to disrupt the status quo, push boundaries and drive innovation – whilst unlocking your own potential.
Working at ST means innovating for a future that we want to make smarter, greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. Join us and start the future!
 YOUR ROLE 
 - Assister les contrôleuses QA pour l’accomplissement de leurs tâches (formation/ Polyvalence, gestion des équipes, …).
 - Suivre les résultats des gates QA daily et weekly, identifier les main detractors et suivre avec l’opération l’amélioration continue des indicateurs QA et l’éradications des problèmes.
 - Assurer le respect et l’application des procédures de travail (SOP, LOP)
 Maintenir la discipline au sein des équipes et veiller sur l’application du règlement intérieur.
 - Suivi weekly du statut et plan d’action du stock GB5.
 - Assurer le déroulement des qualifications suivant la SOP.
 - Participer aux réunions MRB et à la disposition des lots non conformes en assurant le risk assessment.
 - Conduire des audits dans la ligne (Audit produit, équipement, Antimixing, process, …)
 - Suivre le déploiement des actions correctives et d’amélioration engagée dans les 8D clients.
 - Assurer la préparation des audits internes et externes et suivre le déploiement des plans d’actions engagés.
 - Suivre le déploiement et l’effectiveness des programmes d’amélioration (RTP, Zero touch, POR, …)
 - Assurer personnellement l’arrêt des machines qui dérivent pour les raisons suivantes : SPC out of Spec, rejets successifs, équipements non calibrés, paramètres des machines hors spécification, matière première non conforme, opératrices non certifiées, RTP non respecté……
 Your Skills & Experiences
 - Bac + 5 (Ingénieur ou Master option génie industriel, Electronique ou mécanique), avec experience minimale de 3 ans à ST.
 - Bonne connaissance des processus Assemblage et Test
 - Avoir de bonnes connaissances des outils qualité et production (PCMS tool, LEMS, 8D tool, FMEA Tool, Audit tool, …)
 - Maîtrise de l’outil informatique Microsoft office
 - Maturité et respect des personnes.
 - Sens de l’initiative et d’autonomie.
 - Bonne communication et écoute active.
 - Bonne expression écrite et orale en Français et Anglais.

 Activités 
 « Vivre une aventure extraordinaire et unique au sein d’un grand groupe industriel à l’agilité et l’autonomie d’une PME »
Type de contrat : Local ; CDI
Votre fonction
Le Coordinateur Supply Chain se charge de gérer les approvisionnements série de l’entreprise et d’effectuer un suivi régulier avec les fournisseurs. Il s’occupe, également, de la gestion des stocks..
En tant que Coordinateur Supply Chain , vos responsabilités seront les suivantes* :
 - Coordonner les activités entre Appro, production, magasin, transport, douane et ADV.
 - Participer à l’élaboration des plans de production et des besoins en approvisionnement.
 - Suivre les prévisions de la demande et ajuster les plans d’approvisionnement/production.
 - Suivre les commandes fournisseurs avec l’appro. 
 - Assurer la disponibilité des matières premières et composants. 
 - Gérer les relances et anticiper les risques de rupture. 
 - Coordonner avec les équipes logistiques HCIM les opérations de réception. 
 - Garantir la bonne tenue des stocks (exactitude physique et informatique= inventaire tournant selon procédure HCIM). 
 - Veiller à l’application des règles FIFO et des standards Lean/5S. 
 - Planifier et coordonner les expéditions vers les clients avec les équipes HCIM. 
 - Optimiser les coûts et délais de transport en coordination avec les équipes HCIM. 
 - Suivre les indicateurs de performance. 
 - Enregistrer et suivre les commandes clients avec l’ADV. 
 - Assurer la bonne communication vers le client. 
 - Gérer les éventuels litiges (retards, anomalies, réclamations). 
 - Identifier et mettre en œuvre des actions Lean (réduction de gaspillages, optimisation des flux). 
 - Participer aux projets de digitalisation (WMS, TMS, ERP, EDI). 
 - Suivre les indicateurs de performance (OTD, taux de service, taux de rupture, fiabilité des stocks). 
 - Liste non exhaustive
 Compétences et connaissance requises
 - Etre Issu(e) d’une formation Bac +5 en Supply Chain, Logistique, Gestion Industrielle ou équivalent., avec une expérience de 6 ans en minimum dans le secteur aéronautique.
 - Connaissance des processus de planification (MRP II, PIC/PDP) certification APICS est un plus.
 - Bonnes notions en Lean Manufacturing, gestion des flux et incoterms. 
 Votre aisance relationnelle, votre curiosité, mais également vos capacités à être force de proposition et à être tourné(e) vers l’innovation vous permettront de mener à bien vos missions et de vous épanouir sur ce poste.
Vous évoluerez dans un cadre dynamique et en croissance.
Vous bénéficierez de l’agilité et de la souplesse d’une PME alliée à la solidité et aux moyens d’un groupe international qui existe depuis 170 ans.
Vous bénéficierez d’un programme d’intégration personnalisé à votre prise de poste, de formations régulières au sein d’un groupe où les perspectives d’évolution de carrière sont riches et diversifiées.
Nous nous engageons en faveur d’une politique environnementale et sociétale (RSE) en matière de Biodiversité, Diversité & Inclusion, Parentalité, Ethique et Développement des Compétences.
Nous visons la neutralité carbone à horizon 2050 pour l’ensemble de nos activités.
Nous investissons 5% du CA, chaque année depuis 20 ans en faveur de l’innovation pour un « développement durable ».

 Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
 Summary
 What you will do
 As a Product Quality Engineer (PQE), you will provide technical support to the Morocco Dealer Network. Identify, report and manage product quality issues liaising with Volvo Truck Corporation as well as act as an extended arm of Customer Technical Service Department. Support Regional Technical Managers with product quality updates and make joint dealer/customer visits.
 Key Responsibilities
 As the PQE, the main tasks are to:
 - Day to day technical assistance to dealer network via Technical Helpdesk (Argus).
 - Be part of the Helpdesk and VAS rotation.
 - Work closely together with Customer Technical Service within Volvo Maroc.
 - Monitor DQR's (Field/Dealer Quality Reports) and report quality issues using MQR (Market Quality Report) routine.
 - Identify existing solutions and prioritize cases.
 - Evaluate options and prioritize cases.
 - Establish frequency, cost, safety, geographic coverage, customer importance and economic impact.
 - Monitor effectiveness of solutions implemented and give general assistance of the team.
 - Analyze warranty costs and failure frequencies to identify high costs to the MC and make financial support requests to VTC.
 - Support Sales Department by providing input about quality issues and problems arising due to wrongly specified trucks·
 - Work closely with Technical Trainer.
 - Any other duties that may be reasonably requested by your manager.
 - Verify dealer compliance with Volvo Group Trucks standards related to safety, workshop operations, cleanliness, and visual identity.
 - Identify training needs and support dealers in maintenance contracts, service intervals, connected services, and remote diagnostics.
 - Conduct the On-the-Job Training according to real needs.
 - Be in accordance with Volvo Group standards of health, safety, quality, and environmental care. The Volvo values of customer success, performance, change, passion, and trust. Diversity and Inclusion, recognizing that at Volvo we value differences.
 Required Skills, Experience And Competencies
 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.
 - Strong technical knowledge of heavy-duty commercial vehicles and diagnostic processes.
 - Experience in technical support, after-sales service, warranty management, or a similar role within the automotive or commercial vehicle industry.
 - Good understanding of warranty procedures, quality processes, and dealer network operations.
 - Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
 - Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
 - Ability to influence, convince, and build effective relationships with customers and dealers.
 - Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
 - Customer-focused, results-oriented, and proactive approach.
 - Commercial awareness and ability to balance technical and business considerations.
 - Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and perform effectively in a field-based environment.
 Additional Requirements
 - As all documentation and communication are in English, proficiency in English is required.
 - Good working knowledge of IT tools (word, Excel, PP, etc.) is required.
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
 Who We Are And What We Believe In
 We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
At Volvo Trucks you will be part of leading the way towards a sustainable transport industry. For nearly a century we have been innovating for people – to make life easier, better and safer. Driving progress is our promise to customers, to the industry and to society. At Volvo Trucks we share a curiosity to learn, we work with passion and we embrace change to stay ahead. Join us, together we move the world we want to live in.

 Position Overview

 Key Responsibilities

 - Contribute to layout definition and optimization to ensure efficient production flow and space utilization. 
 - Participate in supplier selection and technical validation of equipment and tooling. 
 - Ensure, in collaboration with Quality and HSE teams, the validation, performance, and approval of machines and processes. 
 - Support and train production teams on processes, equipment, and best practices. 
 - Promote innovation by introducing new technologies, automation, and improved manufacturing systems. 
 - Support and assist the team in the execution of development tasks. 
 - Ensure compliance with company standards and automotive requirements (IATF 16949, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and actively support QHSE objectives.

 - Bac+5 with 5 years’ experience working in wiring activities. 
 - Knowledge of Cutting & LP & crimping manufacturing process. 
 - Strong understanding of process optimization methods and techniques. 
 - Strong analytical and synthesis skills. 
 - Problem solving techniques. 
 - Proficiency in both English & French languages, spoken and written

Description du poste
Le/La Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) est responsable de la performance qualité des fournisseurs externes afin de garantir la conformité des produits aux exigences qualité, coûts et délais dans un environnement industriel automobile .
Il/Elle intervient tout au long du cycle de vie fournisseur, depuis le développement jusqu’à la production série, avec un rôle clé dans la sécurisation qualité, la gestion des non-conformités et l’amélioration continue de la performance fournisseurs.
Le poste requiert une forte autonomie dans la gestion des fournisseurs, la résolution de problèmes qualité complexes et la sécurisation des phases d’industrialisation et de démarrage série.
 Responsabilités Principales
 - Piloter de manière autonome un portefeuille de fournisseurs critiques dans un environnement industriel automobile.
 - Assurer la qualification, l’évaluation et l’homologation des fournisseurs.
 - Piloter les activités APQP et PPAP jusqu’à validation en production série.
 - Réaliser les audits fournisseurs (système, process, produit) et suivre les plans d’actions.
 - Gérer les non-conformités fournisseurs et conduire les analyses de causes racines (8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa…).
 - Assurer les escalades qualité en cas de dérives ou situations critiques.
 - Suivre et analyser les KPI qualité fournisseurs (PPM, incidents, coûts de non-qualité, performance livraison).
 - Sécuriser les phases de démarrage série, ramp-up et industrialisation.
 - Gérer les dérogations, changements techniques et validations fournisseurs.
 - Participer aux actions de containment et de sécurisation produit/process.
 - Collaborer avec les équipes internes (achats, industrialisation, production, ingénierie).
 - Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la performance de la supply chain automobile.
 Qualifications
 Formation
 - Bac+5 en Génie Industriel, Qualité, Mécanique, Électromécanique ou équivalent.
 Expérience
 - Minimum 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en qualité fournisseurs dans un environnement industriel automobile.
 - Expérience confirmée en gestion de fournisseurs et industrialisation produit/process.
 - Expérience solide en APQP / PPAP et production série.
 Compétences techniques
 - Maîtrise des outils qualité :
 - APQP
 - PPAP
 - FMEA / AMDEC
 - SPC
 - MSA
 - 8D
 - 5 Why
 - Ishikawa
 - Bonne maîtrise des standards qualité :
 - ISO 9001
 - IATF 16949 (fortement apprécié)
 - VDA 6.3 (atout)
 - Lecture de plans techniques et compréhension des procédés industriels automobiles.
 - Capacité à analyser et challenger les processus fournisseurs.
 Soft Skills
 - Leadership sans autorité hiérarchique.
 - Forte capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
 - Excellent relationnel et communication en environnement multi-acteurs.
 - Rigueur et orientation résultats.
 - Capacité à gérer les priorités et situations de crise.
 - Autonomie et esprit de décision.
 Informations complémentaires
 - Poste à forte responsabilité sur la performance qualité fournisseurs dans un environnement industriel automobile.
 - Forte exposition aux problématiques industrielles et qualité terrain.
 - Rôle clé dans la sécurisation des lancements et de la performance supply chain automobile.
 - Environnement dynamique et exigeant avec forte interaction transverse.

 Job Description
 Location : TFZ Tangier Plant
The Process Engineer will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining injection molding processes to ensure high-quality production, efficiency, and compliance with safety and quality standards. The role involves close collaboration with production, quality, and maintenance teams to drive continuous improvement.
 Responsibilities
 - Process optimization: Develop and refine molding parameters to improve cycle time, reduce scrap, and ensure consistent product quality.
 - Tooling management: Support new mold introduction, tooling validation, and troubleshooting of mold-related issues.
 - Specification creation: Define and develop specifications for injection molding machines (IMM) and all related equipment ‘automation, IMM’s peripherals…’
 - Production support: Assist operators with machine setup, adjustments, and problem-solving during production runs.
 - Quality assurance: Implement scientific molding principles to meet customer specifications and reduce defects.
 - Continuous improvement: Lead initiatives in lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and process standardization.
 - Documentation: Prepare and maintain process sheets, work instructions, and technical reports.
 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work with R&D ‘designers & laboratory tester’, quality, and supply chain teams to support new product launches and ongoing production.
 - Overmolding expertise: Apply knowledge of overmolding processes to ensure proper adhesion, material compatibility, automation and product performance.
 Education Requirements
 - Engineer degree: in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Industrial, or Plastics Engineering
 Experience Requirements
 - 4+ years of experience in injection molding processes (automotive, electronics, or packaging industries preferred).
 - Strong knowledge of scientific molding principles and polymer processing.
 - Experience with troubleshooting molding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and SPC tools.
 Languages
 - Communication skills for cross-department collaboration.
 - Good english level

Chez TRIGO, nous sommes convaincus que la Qualité est essentielle à la performance de l’Industrie et à sa durabilité. C’est pourquoi nous déployons des solutions qui optimisent les productions industrielles, à l'échelle mondiale.

Au sein d'une entreprise à l'esprit start-up et à la culture internationale, vous contribuerez et améliorerez l'efficacité de nombreuses chaines de montage et d’assemblage. Description du poste
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités aéronautiques , nous recrutons un Ingénieur Qualité Aéronautique (H/F) pour intervenir sur des projets industriels à forte exigence réglementaire, en interface directe avec le client et les équipes opérationnelles.
 Missions Principales
 - Piloter la qualité produit et process sur les activités aéronautiques
 - Analyser les non-conformités, définir, mettre en œuvre et suivre les plans d’actions correctifs
 - Garantir le respect des exigences clients et des standards qualité aéronautiques (ISO 9001 / EN 9100)
 - Participer aux activités de validation produit et process (FAI, AMDEC, 8D, analyses causes racines)
 - Former et accompagner les équipes de production et de contrôle sur les outils et méthodes qualité
 - Être l’interlocuteur principal du client sur les sujets qualité, audits et revues qualité
 - Contribuer activement aux démarches d’amélioration continue et à la fiabilité des livrables
 - Veiller à l’application des exigences FOD et des procédures qualité spécifiques aéronautiques
 Qualifications
 Profil recherché :
 - Bac+5 en Qualité, Génie Industriel, Génie Mécanique ou Aéronautique ou équivalent
 - Minimum 2 ans d’expérience en qualité aéronautique
 - Bonne maîtrise des outils qualité : 8D, AMDEC, FAI, QRQC
 - Connaissance des référentiels aéronautiques (EN 9100, exigences clients)
 - Solides compétences en gestion de projet et en relation client
 - Rigueur, autonomie et excellentes capacités de communication
 - Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
 Informations complémentaires
 Nous Offrons
 - Un environnement industriel aéronautique exigeant et stimulant
 - Des conditions de travail sécurisées et conformes aux standards aéronautiques
 - Un accompagnement au développement des compétences techniques et métier
 - Des opportunités d’évolution au sein d’un groupe international reconnu en qualité industrielle

 Pourquoi SCALIAN ?

 Description Du Poste

 Ingénieur Méthodes opérationnel, vous êtes le garant du déploiement efficace et de l'appropriation de la solution MES par les utilisateurs finaux.  Company Description
 Sanden is a major player in the manufacturing of automotive compressors. It was originally founded in 1943 by Kaihei Ushikubo under the name of Sankyo Electric Company and was first manufacturing bicycle lamps. After the war, the company then entered the home electric appliance market and from there began producing refrigeration machines, initially for business use. This became a major turning point in the history of Sanden. In 1970, Sanden began producing air conditioning compressors for passenger cars. It has been pioneering the Scroll-type automotive compressor.
With an established track record in innovation and manufacturing excellence backed by strong support from Hisense, Sanden is transforming the future of mobility to create a safer, greener, and better-connected world. With almost 8,100 employees worldwide, a footprint including 46 global offices and R&D centres across Asia, the Americas and Europe, the company has become a tier one supplier to major OEMs worldwide.
Sanden Europe has its headquarters in Bad Nauheim, Germany, where it also has a R&D center and test facilities. Two manufacturing sites are in Europe: One in Tinténiac, France, the other in Polkowice, Poland. Thanks to the nominations of a European car manufacturer, we are starting a new HVAC plant in Morocco in 2026.
 Job Description
 Join us in this exciting greenfield project as a Supply Chain Manager . You bring strong automotive experience in Supply Chain operations? Have already worked with our client Stellantis? Are you a proven team builder and planner? Be part of our global organization for the establishment of our HVAC plant in Tangier. Your mission consists of leading the Supply Chain department within budget to meet customer requirements, internal standards and KPI targets.
 Essential Responsibilities
 - Develop and implement the supply chain strategy, policies, and procedures to drive operational excellence and financial performance
 - Ensure seamless operations and proactively anticipate customer needs to maximize satisfaction and guarantee zero disruptions or complaints
 - Oversee all supply chain activities, ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and company standards, including EHS, QMS, customer requirements, import/export and customs laws
 - Align planning, sourcing, procurement, production, and delivery processes with current and future demand to ensure timely fulfillment
 - Optimize logistics, inventory, and material flow to ensure cost-effective and timely delivery while meeting customer requirements
 - Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supply chain department, reporting on progress and driving continuous improvement
 - Prepare and manage annual supply chain budgets (OPEX & CAPEX), including forecasting and project oversight
 - Manage and evaluate suppliers and logistics partners’ performance, driving improvements and cost savings
 - Ensure readiness and compliance with all internal and external audits related to supply chain activities
 - Lead, coach, and develop the supply chain teams to achieve plant objectives, continuous improvement, and cost reductions
 Other Responsibilities
 - Maintain effective cross-functional communication and coordination with other departments to ensure alignment and achievement of plant targets
 - Monitor market trends, internal business initiatives, and projects that may affect supply and demand; assess and communicate their impact on supply chain activities to relevant stakeholders
 - Benchmark supply chain practices with other plants to identify, share, and implement best practices
 Qualifications
 Required experience and education:
 - At least 5 years of proven experience as Supply Chain Manager within the automotive industry
 - Contribution to a greenfield or start-up project is appreciated

 Your Must Haves
 - In-depth knowledge and proficiency in Supply Chain management systems (planning, sourcing, procurement, Inventory, demand analysis, transport, and deliveries) 
 - Advanced user of SAP and MRP/ERP system with an understanding of order generation logic 
 - Financial acumen with the ability to manage Profit & Loss responsibilities, oversee and optimize budgets for cost-effective operations (OPEX & CAPEX) 
 - Customer facing experience with Stellantis 
 - Proven capacity to ensure full compliance of Supply Chain processes with IATF standard 
 - Skilled in analyzing complex issues, implementing effective solutions and making sound decisions 
 - Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to manage, coach and develop high-performing teams in challenging situations and deliver plant objectives 
 - Excellent negotiation skills for managing suppliers, contracts and partnerships to achieve cost savings and performance improvements. 
 - Outstanding communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to coordinate and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders 
 - Exceptional organizational abilities, including time management and planning, to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment 
 Your Nice-to-Haves
 - Understanding of Lean manufacturing tools and methods
 - Greenfield experience
 - Experience in developing internal processes (procedures, work instructions and records)
 Additional Information
Local mobility required and international travel possible (France, Germany, China)

 At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. 
 Job Overview
 Coordinates and integrates the flow of materials and information among suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and customers and identifies opportunities for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the supply chain.
 Your main tasks
 - 1. Monitoring & Early Detection (Signals)
 - Monitor supplier-related alerts and respond to urgent issues based on predefined escalation criteria
 - Review supplier performance vs. committed capacity and flag deviations
 - Monitor Supplier Heatmap to identify risks impacting fill rate and delivery performance
 - Review potential red risks related to tooling or capacity via IBP / planning systems
 - Issue Management & Tracking
 - Maintain and update supplier constraint visibility through tools such as GCM
 - Track and review Past Due (PD) top offenders and highlight systemic risks
 - Support preparation of escalation packages with data, impact, and root cause insights
 - Analysis & S&OP Preparation
 - Support Past Due projections and supply risk outlook for S&OP cycles
 - Consolidate supplier feedback and improvement actions into structured S&OP inputs
 - Provide analytical insights on supplier constraints, capacity gaps, and recovery outlook
 - Coordination & Decision Support
 - Prepare data inputs and analysis for capacity review and consensus discussions
 - Support cross-functional alignment by translating data into actionable insights
 - Track tooling and capacity-related timelines and highlight risks or delays
 - Systems & Data Management
 - Log and maintain supply constraints and updates in planning systems (e.g., GCM, IBP)
 - Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness across supplier performance tracking tools
 - Support reporting automation and continuous improvement of supply visibility dashboards
 - Continuous Improvement & Transformation
 - Support deployment and adoption of supplier collaboration tools (e.g., SupplyOn)
 - Identify opportunities to improve data visibility, reporting efficiency, and planning processes
 - Drive standardization of supplier monitoring and reporting practices
 Your ideal Background
 - 2–5 years of experience in Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, or Operations
 - Experience in supplier performance management, capacity tracking, or materials planning preferred
 - Exposure to S&OP / IBP processes and demand-supply balancing
 - Strong experience with data analytics, reporting, and performance tracking tools
 - Experience working with global teams and offshore delivery models preferred
 Competencies
 Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

 Responsable Production Senior (H/F)
 Casablanca – Bouskoura
 Notre client est un groupe industriel international de premier plan, spécialisé dans la conception et la fabrication de solutions électroniques et de systèmes d'interconnexion destinés aux secteurs de l'aérospatial, de l'aéronautique, de la défense et des environnements critiques. Dans le cadre du développement de son site de production basé à Casablanca – Bouskoura, il recrute un(e) Responsable Production Senior .
 Votre mission
 Rattaché(e) à la Direction Générale , vous définissez et pilotez la stratégie industrielle du site. Vous êtes garant(e) de la performance globale des opérations de production en assurant l'atteinte des objectifs en matière de sécurité, qualité, coûts, délais et satisfaction client.
Véritable acteur clé de l'organisation, vous accompagnez la croissance du site en développant une culture d'excellence opérationnelle, en optimisant les processus industriels et en mobilisant les équipes autour de la performance.
 Vos principales responsabilités
 - Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de production en cohérence avec les orientations de la Direction Générale.
 - Piloter l'ensemble des activités de fabrication afin de garantir les objectifs de qualité, coûts, délais, sécurité et productivité.
 - Manager, accompagner et développer les équipes de production en favorisant la responsabilisation, la montée en compétences et la performance collective.
 - Assurer une planification optimale des ressources humaines, techniques et matérielles afin de répondre aux exigences de production.
 - Déployer des démarches d'amélioration continue (Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, résolution de problèmes) afin d'améliorer durablement les performances industrielles.
 - Superviser les projets d'industrialisation, les transferts de production, les montées en cadence ainsi que les évolutions des moyens industriels.
 - Garantir la conformité des produits aux exigences clients ainsi qu'aux référentiels qualité applicables aux industries de haute technologie.
 - Définir, suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance (KPI) et mettre en œuvre les plans d'actions nécessaires.
 - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Qualité, Supply Chain, Méthodes, Maintenance, Industrialisation, Ingénierie et Achats afin d'assurer la fluidité des opérations.
 - Contribuer aux projets d'investissement, d'automatisation et de transformation industrielle visant à renforcer la compétitivité du site.
 - Veiller au respect des règles de Santé, Sécurité et Environnement ainsi qu'à la conformité réglementaire.
 - Être force de proposition auprès de la Direction Générale sur les axes d'amélioration de la performance industrielle et du développement du site.
 Profil recherché
 - Diplôme d'Ingénieur ou Bac+5 en Génie Industriel, Génie Mécanique, Génie Électrique, Électronique, Électromécanique ou équivalent.
 - Expérience professionnelle de 20 ans minimum, dont une expérience confirmée dans le management d'un site ou d'un département de production industrielle.
 - Une expérience dans les secteurs de l'aéronautique, de l'aérospatial, de la défense, de l'électronique ou de l'industrie de haute précision est fortement appréciée.
 - Solide maîtrise des méthodes Lean Manufacturing et des outils d'amélioration continue.
 - Bonne connaissance des référentiels qualité (EN9100/AS9100, ISO 9001 ou équivalents).
 - Expérience confirmée dans le pilotage de projets d'industrialisation et de transformation industrielle.
 - Bonne maîtrise des outils ERP et des indicateurs de pilotage de la performance.
 - Français et anglais professionnels.
 Compétences recherchées
 - Leadership affirmé et capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires.
 - Excellentes compétences en management et en conduite du changement.
 - Vision stratégique et forte orientation résultats.
 - Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et capacité de prise de décision.
 - Rigueur, organisation et sens des priorités.
 - Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication.
 - Culture de l'excellence opérationnelle et de l'amélioration continue.
 Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
 Vous intégrerez un groupe industriel international reconnu pour son savoir-faire technologique et son niveau d'exigence, offrant un environnement de travail innovant, des projets industriels à forte valeur ajoutée et de réelles perspectives d'évolution.
 Localisation : Casablanca – Bouskoura
 Type de contrat : CDI
 Rémunération : Attractive, selon profil et expérience.
Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi au sein d'un environnement industriel de haute technologie et contribuer au développement d'un site stratégique ? Nous serons ravis d'étudier votre candidature.

 +66K 🌍 HR Development Manager Safran | Employer Branding |
 Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense.

 • Garantir l'identification des risques potentiels dans la chaîne logistique et la mise en place des plans d'action pour les atténuer,
 • Garantir la mise place des standards : 5S, QRQC, IP, Kaizen, standards SAE, etc.
 Parlons de vous : 
 - Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur industriel / Logistique 
 - Expérience : une expérience de 5 à 7 dans la gestion de Flux au sein d'un structure industrielle de préférence dans le domaine aéronautique ou automobile.

 Soft Skills :

 Company Overview 
 Build your brand. Tell your story. Make a lasting impact!
 Stellantis is a leading global automaker and mobility provider, delivering clean, connected, affordable, and safe mobility solutions. Our strength lies in the breadth of our iconic brand portfolio, the diversity and passion of our people, and our deep roots in the communities where we operate.
 Driven by ambitious electrification and software strategies, and the creation of an innovative ecosystem of strategic, game-changing partnerships, Stellantis is transforming into a sustainable mobility tech company.
 Job Summary 
 As part of the Fastlane 2030 strategy, regional governance is taking a leading role in driving business performance, with the MEA region targeting more than 40% growth.
 The Supply Chain Transformation Manager is responsible for driving and coordinating the regional Supply Chain transformation agenda across all functions. The role ensures that each Supply Chain entity defines, maintains, and executes a clear transformation roadmap aligned with regional priorities and global standards.
 The position provides governance over transformation initiatives by structuring, consolidating, monitoring, and challenging project portfolios to ensure consistency, visibility, execution discipline, and value creation. The manager establishes and maintains a single integrated transformation roadmap that enables clear decision-making and transparent communication across all stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Drive the regional Supply Chain transformation roadmap across all Supply Chain entities, including Demand, Supply, IRF, Inbound, Vehicle Logistics, and Supply Chain Projects.
 - Gather, consolidate, review, and challenge transformation initiatives to ensure strategic alignment and execution consistency.
 - Ensure all transformation roadmaps are aligned with regional business objectives and global Supply Chain transformation guidelines.
 - Support project managers in developing robust business cases, including financial validation, KPI definition, and measurable business value.
 - Coordinate project approval processes through the appropriate governance bodies (ICT Budget Committee, VCP, AI Hub, and other relevant forums).
 - Partner with the New Programs team to deliver digital transformation initiatives supporting new program launches and operational evolution.
 - Organize and facilitate the regional Supply Chain transformation governance, including:
 - Monthly portfolio reviews at VP level.
 - Quarterly transformation reviews at SVP level.
 - Portfolio prioritization and monitoring.
 - Execution tracking.
 - Risk identification and escalation management.
 - Monitor project progress, identify execution risks, and ensure corrective actions are implemented where necessary.
 - Promote cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful delivery of transformation initiatives across the MEA region.
 - Ensure transparency through consolidated reporting, governance dashboards, and executive-level communication.
 Competencies and Qualifications 
 Education 
 - Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Experience 
 - Minimum 10 years of experience in Supply Chain, Transformation, Project Management, or Business Excellence.
 - Proven experience managing cross-functional transformation or strategic projects within an international environment.
 - Experience working with governance frameworks, portfolio management, and business case development.
 Languages 
 - Fluent English is mandatory.
 - French, Arabic, Turkish, or Italian are considered strong advantages.
 Preferred Skills & Competencies 
 - Project and Portfolio Management
 - Supply Chain Transformation
 - Business Case Development
 - Change Management
 - Process Improvement
 - Digital Transformation
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Executive Communication
 - KPI & Performance Management
 - Data Analysis and Process Intelligence
 - Risk Management
 Personal Attributes 
 - Strong ownership and autonomy
 - Strategic and analytical mindset
 - Results-oriented with excellent execution capabilities
 - Collaborative and influential
 - Strong organizational and communication skills
 - Ability to work in a complex international matrix organization
 Specialized Knowledge 
 - Supply Chain Management
 - PMO (Project Management Office)
 - Business Transformation methodologies
 - Knowledge of AI and Digital Transformation initiatives is an advantage.
 Mobility 
 - Willingness to travel within the MEA region and Europe when its needed
 Internal Stakeholders 
 - MEA Supply Chain Leadership Team
 - Global Supply Chain Transformation Team
 - Data & AI Team
 - Supply Chain Academy
 - ICT
 - Finance
 - New Programs Team
 - Regional and Global PMO
 What we offer 
 Joining Stellantis means gaining access to a wealth of opportunities and benefits, including:
 - Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing professional development and advancement, ensuring you're always at the forefront of industry trends and innovations.
 - Global Exposure: Exposure to a global work environment, where you'll collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and cultures, broadening your horizons and expanding your network.
 - Inclusive Culture: An inclusive and collaborative company culture, where every voice is valued and respected, fostering a sense of belonging and camaraderie among our team members.
 - Expert Mentorship: Mentorship from industry experts who are dedicated to sharing their knowledge and guiding you on your career journey, providing invaluable insights and support along the way.
 Diversity engagement 
 At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans l'optimisation de leurs infrastructures, en garantissant des environnements de travail sécurisés, performants et durables. Nous recrutons un(e) Responsable Méthodes pour notre site basé à Casablanca afin de piloter l'amélioration continue des processus techniques et opérationnels, coordonner les équipes travaux et maintenance, et garantir la performance, la sécurité et la qualité des interventions sur nos patrimoines.
 Missions principales :
 - Définir, déployer et faire évoluer les méthodes et procédures techniques (maintenance, interventions curatives et préventives, chantiers de réhabilitation) pour assurer l'efficacité et la conformité des opérations.
 - Piloter l'optimisation des processus : standardisation des modes opératoires, réduction des temps d'intervention, planification et coordination multi-sites.
 - Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPI) liés à la maintenance, au taux de résolution, aux coûts et aux délais, et proposer des actions correctives et d'amélioration continue.
 - Coordonner les équipes techniques internes et les prestataires externes : définition des tâches, priorisation des interventions, contrôle qualité et respect des délais.
 - Établir et suivre les plannings d'intervention (préventif et curatif), gérer les réservations de ressources et optimiser l'affectation des équipes et des moyens matériels.
 - Rédiger, mettre à jour et diffuser les procédures, modes opératoires et fiches techniques ; assurer la capitalisation des retours d'expérience et l'archivage documentaire.
 - Assurer la conformité réglementaire et la sécurité des interventions : contrôle des EPI, respect des procédures de sécurité, gestion des habilitations et sensibilisation des équipes.
 - Participer à l'élaboration des budgets opérationnels, suivre les coûts d'exploitation liés aux travaux et proposer des leviers d'optimisation.
 - Accompagner la digitalisation des processus (outils de GMAO, reporting, tableaux de bord) et contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes sur ces outils.
 - Rendre compte régulièrement à la hiérarchie de l'état d'avancement des plans d'action, des risques identifiés et des résultats obtenus.
 Qualifications requises :
 - Formation technique de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 en maintenance, génie industriel, bâtiment ou équivalent, ou expérience significative dans des fonctions méthodes / coordination technique.
 - Expérience souhaitée de 3 à 5 ans minimum sur un poste similaire, idéalement en facility management, gestion immobilière ou maintenance multi-sites.
 - Bonne connaissance des processus de maintenance, GMAO, planification, méthodes et outils d'amélioration continue (5S, Lean, TPM, etc.).
 - Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des solutions de gestion de maintenance ; capacité à produire des rapports et tableaux de bord pertinents.
 - Rigueur, sens de l'organisation, autonomie et capacité à prioriser des actions dans un contexte multi-sites et contraintes opérationnelles.
 - Qualités relationnelles et aptitude au management transverse : fédérer des équipes, piloter des prestataires et travailler en collaboration avec des interlocuteurs variés.
 - Orientation résultats, sens du service client et capacité à formaliser des processus clairs et applicables sur le terrain.
 - Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels sur les sites de Casablanca et sa région.

Chez TRIGO, nous sommes convaincus que la Qualité est essentielle à la performance de l’Industrie et à sa durabilité. C’est pourquoi nous déployons des solutions qui optimisent les productions industrielles, à l'échelle mondiale.

Au sein d'une entreprise à l'esprit start-up et à la culture internationale, vous contribuerez et améliorerez l'efficacité de nombreuses chaines de montage et d’assemblage. Grâce à des missions engageantes et responsabilisantes, vous constaterez l'impact de vos efforts. Rejoignez une équipe engagée qui vise l'excellence !
Description du poste
En tant que Responsable Qualité Système (SMQ/SMI), vous êtes garant(e) du déploiement, du maintien et de l’amélioration du système de management de la qualité conformément aux normes internationales ISO 9001, IATF 16949, EN 9100 et ISO 14001.
Vous assurez la structuration du système qualité, la gestion des audits, le suivi des certifications et la performance globale du système qualité.
 Vos Principales Missions
 - Déployer et maintenir le système de management de la qualité (SMQ/SMI)
 - Assurer la conformité aux normes ISO et aux exigences clients
 - Piloter les audits internes et externes ainsi que les plans d’actions associés
 - Préparer et suivre les audits de certification et de renouvellement
 - Gérer les indicateurs qualité (KPI), non-conformités et actions correctives
 - Rédiger, mettre à jour et structurer la documentation qualité
 - Animer les revues de direction et les processus qualité
 - Piloter l’amélioration continue et le déploiement des bonnes pratiques
 - Assurer la coordination avec les équipes internes, clients et auditeurs
 Qualifications
 - Bac+3 à 5: en Qualité, Génie Industriel ou équivalent
 - Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en système de management de la qualité (SMQ/SMI)
 - Expérience confirmée en audits internes et externes
 - Maîtrise des normes ISO 9001, IATF 16949, EN 9100, ISO 14001
 - Bonne maîtrise des outils qualité : 8D, AMDEC, QRQC, PDCA, Ishikawa, Pareto, DMAIC
 - Expérience en environnement industriel (automobile ou aéronautique fortement souhaitée)
 - Bon niveau de français et d’anglais
 - Capacité à travailler en environnement multi-sites et transverse
 Informations complémentaires
 - Poste basé à Tanger
 - Environnement industriel international
 - Forte exposition aux clients et aux audits
 - Opportunités de développement dans un groupe international.
